sources.sentence: On holiday, we talked without constantly watching the clock.

brief.meaningEn: Without repeatedly checking the time because of pressure to stop or move to the next obligation.
brief.meaningZh: 不用因趕下一項安排或快要結束，而反覆留意時間。
brief.grammar: talk/read/spend an afternoon without constantly watching the clock; watching the clock is attention to time and the end of an activity, not simply noticing what a clock looks like
brief.boundaryZh: 形容當時沒有不停趕時間，不表示永遠沒有期限或不知道幾點；需說哪段時間及安排。
brief.misconceptionZh: 形容當時沒有不停趕時間，不表示永遠沒有期限或不知道幾點；需說哪段時間及安排。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「不用不斷惦記時間」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: We left the afternoon free, so my sister and I could finish our conversation without constantly watching the clock; we still knew we had to leave for the station at six.
listening.zh: 我們把下午留空，所以我和姊姊可不用不斷惦記時間地談完話；仍知道六點需出發去車站。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 兩人有一段較從容談話時間，仍有六點離開的安排。
兩人因不知車站出發時間而無法決定何時離開。
兩人每說幾句便看時間，怕錯過下午另一活動。
姊姊獨自離開後，說話者才有時間開始談話。

listening.explanationZh: free afternoon 與六點離開可並存：不反覆趕時間，不是完全沒有時間安排。

reply.promptEn: Why did you keep the afternoon free?
reply.promptZh: 你們為甚麼把下午留空？

options.en: We wanted to talk without constantly watching the clock before leaving at six.
options.zh: 我們想六點離開前，不用不斷惦記時間地談話。

options.en: My sister and I wanted enough room to finish the conversation.
options.zh: 我和姊姊想有足夠時間談完話。

options.en: Another activity in the middle would have made us keep checking how long we had.
options.zh: 中間再排活動，便會令我們不停核還有多久。

options.en: We wanted a relaxed interval together, while keeping the station departure in mind.
options.zh: 我們想有一段從容共處時間，也記着去車站的出發安排。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物知道圖書館五點關門，三點便坐下讀書；她兩小時內投入故事，沒有反覆算剩多少分鐘。同伴以為只有不知道關門時間才可用這表達。哪句較準確？

options.en: She read without constantly watching the clock, even though she knew when the library would close.
options.zh: 即使知道圖書館何時關門，她仍不用不斷惦記時間地讀書。

options.en: She kept checking the remaining time between chapters because closing time was approaching.
options.zh: 關門時間快到，她每章之間都查剩餘時間。

options.en: She only began reading after she had forgotten when the library closed.
options.zh: 她忘記圖書館何時關門後，才開始讀書。

scene.explanationZh: 知道期限與反覆趕時間不同；投入讀書不要求忘記關門時間。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 without constantly watching the clock 得出？

options.en: 當事人這段活動中不用反覆留意剩餘時間。
當事人之後沒有任何需按時履行的安排。
仍可知道何時離開，也能較從容完成當下活動。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有不斷看鐘，不等於沒有之後安排。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友提議把原留空的下午再加兩場短活動，你想保留跟姊姊談話的時間。哪句回應最合適？

options.en: I hoped we could talk without constantly watching the clock; could we leave those visits for another day?
options.zh: 我原想不用不斷惦記時間地談話；可否把那兩次探訪留另一天？

options.en: Let us keep both visits and shorten the conversation whenever the next activity is due.
options.zh: 保留兩次探訪，到下一活動時間便縮短談話吧。

options.en: We can decide how long to talk only after we have arrived at the station.
options.zh: 可等到了車站，才決定談多久。

dialogue.explanationZh: 把想保留的從容談話及替代日子說清，不先填滿時段或等活動已過才定。

speaking.en: I would like an afternoon to read without constantly watching the clock before each new appointment.
speaking.zh: 我想有一個下午讀書，不用在每項新約會前不斷惦記時間。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說想保留哪段從容時間。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你安排給長輩的口述訪問，發現上次每十分鐘便轉問題，令對方剛開始故事就被打斷。這次你想向合作者提議只選一個主題，預留較長時段，也先跟長輩約好休息時間。用一至兩句英文提出安排。

examples.en: Could we choose one topic so she can tell the story without constantly watching the clock? Let us agree a break time with her instead of moving to a new question every ten minutes.
examples.zh: 可否只選一主題，讓她不用不斷惦記時間地講故事？我們跟她議休息時間，不每十分鐘轉新問題吧。

examples.en: I would like her to speak without constantly watching the clock, with room to finish one memory. We could set a longer session and ask when she would like a break.
examples.zh: 我想讓她不用不斷惦記時間地說話，有空間講完一段回憶。可安排較長時段，並問她何時想休息。

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出一個主題及足夠時間，跟受訪者商量休息；不把從容變成無限延長或忽略對方需要。

takeaways.en: They shared lunch without constantly watching the clock because the next meeting had been moved to the following day.
takeaways.zh: 下次會議移到翌日，他們午餐可不用不斷惦記時間。

takeaways.en: I wanted the children to explore the exhibition without constantly watching the clock, so I booked the later return train.
takeaways.zh: 我想孩子參觀展覽不用不斷惦記時間，所以訂較晚回程火車。

sources.sentence: Those friendships outlast the trip itself.

brief.meaningEn: Continue to exist or matter after the journey has ended.
brief.meaningZh: 旅程結束後，某種關係、影響或感受仍然延續。
brief.grammar: friendships/memories outlast the trip itself; outlast is transitive and compares how long two things continue; itself emphasises the journey as the comparison point
brief.boundaryZh: 比旅行持久不等於永久不變，也不表示大家仍在同一地方；需指出旅行後仍在的具體連繫或影響。
brief.misconceptionZh: 比旅行持久不等於永久不變，也不表示大家仍在同一地方；需指出旅行後仍在的具體連繫或影響。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「旅行結束後仍然延續」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Outlast is an ordinary duration verb. In the source, friendships continue beyond a journey; this is not an opaque travel idiom.

listening.en: The friendship outlasted the trip itself: after returning to different cities, Maya and I still exchanged book recommendations and arranged a call each month.
listening.zh: 友誼在旅行結束後仍延續：回到不同城市後，Maya 和我仍交換書籍推薦，每月約一次通話。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 兩人回到不同城市後，仍以推薦書及通話維持友誼。
兩人為維持友誼而把旅程延長一個月，尚未回家。
兩人只在旅行中談過書，回家後已沒有聯絡。
兩人每月一起再旅行，沒有在不同城市通話。

listening.explanationZh: after returning 與 still exchanged/call 顯示旅後延續，不是旅程本身未結束。

reply.promptEn: How do you know the friendship continued after you went home?
reply.promptZh: 回家後，你怎知道友誼仍延續？

options.en: It outlasted the trip itself, with book recommendations and regular calls after we returned.
options.zh: 回來後仍薦書及定期通話，友誼在旅行結束後仍延續。

options.en: We stayed in touch even after going back to different cities.
options.zh: 即使回到不同城市，我們仍保持聯絡。

options.en: The conversation did not end when the journey did.
options.zh: 談話沒有隨旅程結束而終止。

options.en: Our monthly calls gave the connection a place in our ordinary routines.
options.zh: 每月通話讓這份連繫成為平常生活的一部分。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 一位學生回來後只在首晚傳合照，之後未回覆訊息；朋友說只憑那張照已足以知道友誼會持續很多年。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: The photograph shows some contact after the return, but not that the friendship will outlast the trip itself for years.
options.zh: 照片顯示回來後有過聯絡，但未能證明友誼會在旅程結束後延續多年。

options.en: Sending the photograph confirms that regular contact will continue for years.
options.zh: 傳照片確認定期聯絡會延續多年。

options.en: The photograph was sent during the trip rather than after the student returned.
options.zh: 照片在旅行途中傳出，不是在學生回來後。

scene.explanationZh: 一則旅後訊息不足以證長久維持，也不能把旅後訊息移成旅行途中。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 a friendship outlasted the trip itself 得出？

options.en: 友誼在旅行結束後仍在。
友誼之後必定永遠不變。
可用旅後聯絡或共同活動說明延續。

contrast.explanationZh: 比較持續時間，不保證未來永久不變。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說兩人已住不同城市，旅行一完就不能再算旅途結識的友誼；你知道他們仍每月通話。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: Their friendship outlasted the trip itself; the monthly calls show that living apart did not end the contact.
options.zh: 他們的友誼在旅行結束後仍延續；每月通話顯示分居不同地方沒令聯絡終止。

options.en: We should describe them as still travelling together because they have kept the friendship.
options.zh: 因他們保留友誼，應說他們仍一起旅行。

options.en: I would judge whether the friendship continued only by how close their homes are.
options.zh: 我只按兩人住得多近，判友誼有否延續。

dialogue.explanationZh: 看旅後實際聯絡，不把友誼延續混成仍旅行，也不只按住址距離。

speaking.en: I hoped our shared interest in music would outlast the trip itself, so I sent him the recording we had discussed.
speaking.zh: 我希望共同音樂興趣在旅行結束後仍延續，便把談過的錄音傳給他。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說旅後延續的內容及行動。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替學校旅後交流會寫短邀請。你希望同學分享旅程結束後仍影響日常的一件事，可以是繼續讀某作者、用新方法觀察社區或與人聯絡；你不預設每個人都交到長久朋友。用一至兩句英文邀請大家帶一個具體例子。

examples.en: Did anything you discovered outlast the trip itself? Bring one example of a book you kept reading, a habit you continued or a connection you chose to maintain.
examples.zh: 你發現的事物有沒有在旅行結束後仍延續？帶一個例子：回來繼續讀的書、保持的習慣或選擇維持的連繫。

examples.en: At our meeting, we would like to hear what outlasted the trip itself in your everyday life. You could share a new way of noticing your neighbourhood, without needing a story about a lasting friendship.
examples.zh: 交流會想聽甚麼在旅行結束後仍留在日常。可分享觀察社區的新方法，不一定要說長久友誼。

glossary.en: a connection you chose to maintain

writing.selfCheckZh: 邀具體旅後延續例子，保留多種影響；不預設人人相同經歷，也不把希望延續當已永遠成立。

takeaways.en: The habit of sketching ordinary streets outlasted the trip itself and became part of her weekends at home.
takeaways.zh: 畫平常街道的習慣在旅行結束後仍延續，成了她在家周末的一部分。

takeaways.en: Their argument outlasted the trip itself, and they arranged a conversation after returning to discuss what had gone wrong.
takeaways.zh: 他們的爭執在旅行結束後仍延續，所以回來後約談哪裏出了問題。

lessons.titleEn: The bags are put away, but the memories stay with us
lessons.titleZh: 行李已收好，回憶仍留心中

target.pattern: \bthe bags are put away, but the memories stay with us\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: After returning, the memory stays unpacked in the mind for years.
sources.expression: the memory stays unpacked in the mind for years

brief.meaningEn: The journey and practical unpacking are over, while its remembered experiences remain present in everyday life.
brief.meaningZh: 旅行和整理行李已結束，但經歷仍被記起、留在日常生活。
brief.grammar: The bags are put away, but the memories stay with us; a creative contrast between finished practical unpacking and continuing recollection
brief.boundaryZh: 回憶仍在不等於每項細節準確或感受永久不變；需指出現在記得哪段經驗，不把比喻當行李仍未整理。
brief.misconceptionZh: 回憶仍在不等於每項細節準確或感受永久不變；需指出現在記得哪段經驗，不把比喻當行李仍未整理。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「行李已收好，回憶仍留心中」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Creative luggage-and-memory contrast, not a fixed idiom. The physical bags can be stored away while a remembered encounter continues to matter.

listening.en: The bags are put away, but the memories stay with us: a month after the journey, we still talk about the stranger who helped us find the family’s old street.
listening.zh: 行李已收好，回憶仍留心中：旅程一月後，我們仍談幫我們找到家人舊街道的陌生人。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 旅行已結束，兩人仍記起那次幫忙。
兩人回家一月仍未整理行李，只在找失去的物品。
陌生人每月都再帶他們去同一街道。
兩人已不記得旅途中誰曾幫忙。

listening.explanationZh: put away 與 a month after 說實際旅程已完，still talk 說經歷仍被記起。

reply.promptEn: What remains with you a month after the journey?
reply.promptZh: 旅程一月後，甚麼仍留在你心中？

options.en: The bags are put away, but the memories stay with us, especially the help we received in finding that street.
options.zh: 行李已收好，回憶仍留心中，尤其找到那條街時受到的幫助。

options.en: We still talk about the person who helped us find the old address.
options.zh: 我們仍談幫忙找到舊地址的人。

options.en: One unexpected act of kindness has become part of our conversations at home.
options.zh: 一次意外好意成了我們在家談話的一部分。

options.en: The journey is over, though that encounter is still easy to bring to mind.
options.zh: 旅程已完，但那次相遇仍很容易想起。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 學生已收好行李，卻忘記照片中兩人名字；她仍清楚記得大家一起唱歌的感受。有人以為回憶留下就表示每個名字都記得。哪句較準確？

options.en: The line “The bags are put away, but the memories stay with us” can describe the remembered singing without claiming every name is clear.
options.zh: 「行李已收好，回憶仍留心中」可描述記得唱歌，不聲稱每個名字都清楚。

options.en: Remembering the feeling confirms that the student can identify everyone in the photograph.
options.zh: 記得感受確認學生可認照片中每人。

options.en: She could repeat the song’s words, although she has forgotten the names of the singers.
options.zh: 即使忘了唱歌者的名字，她仍能重述歌詞。

scene.explanationZh: 資料只說記得一起唱歌的感受，未說可認清每人或重述歌詞；回憶可以保留部分，而非所有細節都清楚。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由這個行李與回憶的對比得出？

options.en: 旅行已完，某段經驗仍被想起。
回憶仍在，就證明每項細節都準確。
仍可指出記得甚麼，以及哪些地方需問別人。

contrast.explanationZh: 可記得重要經歷，同時留有不清或需核的細節。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說你們仍談旅途陌生人，便以為行李一定未整理好。哪句回應較自然？

options.en: The bags are put away, but the memories stay with us; I mean that the encounter still matters, not that we have left the cases open.
options.zh: 行李已收好，回憶仍留心中；我指那次相遇仍重要，不是行李箱沒關。

options.en: I took remembering the encounter to mean we were still occupied with unpacking the cases.
options.zh: 我把記得相遇理解成仍忙着整理箱子。

options.en: I took the line to mean we were planning to repeat the trip, rather than remembering one encounter.
options.zh: 我把那句理解成我們正計劃重遊，不是仍記起一次相遇。

dialogue.explanationZh: 回憶延續與整理進度、打算重遊是不同事情；這句以行李對比仍重要的相遇。

speaking.en: The bags are put away, but the memories stay with us whenever that song reminds us of our first evening together.
speaking.zh: 行李已收好，回憶仍留心中；每次那首歌都令我們想起首次共度的晚上。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪件事喚起旅後回憶。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寄一張謝卡給旅行時接待你的朋友。已回家並整理好物品，但每次做早餐，仍想起對方教你擺杯子、邊吃邊談家鄉的早晨。用一至兩句英文感謝這段留在日常的回憶，不聲稱可逐字記得全部談話。

examples.en: The bags are put away, but the memories stay with us. Setting out the breakfast cups still reminds me of the mornings at your table, and I am grateful for that welcome.
examples.zh: 行李已收好，回憶仍留心中。擺早餐杯仍讓我想起你餐桌旁的早晨，我很感謝那份歡迎。

examples.en: The bags are put away, but the memories stay with us. Thank you for the mornings of shared breakfast and talk about home; they come back to me whenever I set the table.
examples.zh: 行李已收好，回憶仍留心中。謝謝一起早餐、談家鄉的早晨；每當擺餐桌，它們便再浮現。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把謝意連到現在會喚起的具體早晨經歷；不把行李比喻誤讀成未整理，也不補談話逐字引文。

takeaways.en: The bags are put away, but the memories stay with us: the smell of oranges still brings back our conversation in the market.
takeaways.zh: 行李已收好，回憶仍留心中：橙香仍讓我們想起市場那段談話。

takeaways.en: The bags are put away, but the memories stay with us, including the awkward mistake we can now laugh about together.
takeaways.zh: 行李已收好，回憶仍留心中，包括現在可一起笑談的尷尬錯誤。

sources.sentence: They shared a house but were running on different tracks.

brief.meaningEn: Follow separate routines or directions with little shared time or coordination.
brief.meaningZh: 各自沿不同生活安排或方向前進，缺少共同時間或配合。
brief.grammar: we are/were running on different tracks; tracks are separate railway routes used as a life-routine image; explain whose routines differ and how
brief.boundaryZh: 不同步調不自動代表爭吵、不關心或無法合作；需有具體時段、方向或交流差異。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不同步調不自動代表爭吵、不關心或無法合作；需有具體時段、方向或交流差異。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「同住卻各有各的步調」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Creative railway metaphor for separate routines. It does not name actual railway travel or supply a psychological diagnosis.

listening.en: Although we shared a flat, we were running on different tracks: I left for work before dawn and Leah came home after midnight, so most of our conversations were notes beside the kettle.
listening.zh: 雖然同住，我們卻各有各的步調：我天亮前上班，Leah 午夜後才回家，所以大部分談話成了水壺旁的字條。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 作息錯開，兩人主要靠字條交流，未描述爭吵。
兩人每天同時下班，在水壺旁長談。
兩人已搬到不同住處，只在旅途中碰面。
兩人工作時段已變相同，字條只是記採購清單。

listening.explanationZh: before dawn/after midnight 說錯開作息；同住不等於有共同清醒時間。

reply.promptEn: Why did you mostly leave notes for each other?
reply.promptZh: 你們為甚麼主要留字條給對方？

options.en: We were running on different tracks, with very different working hours.
options.zh: 我們各有各的步調，工作時間差很遠。

options.en: I left early and Leah got back after I was usually asleep.
options.zh: 我很早離開，Leah 回來時我通常已睡。

options.en: There was little time when we were both at home and awake.
options.zh: 我們同在家又醒着的時間很少。

options.en: The notes gave us a way to communicate around our separate routines.
options.zh: 字條讓我們在各自作息間有交流方法。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 兩名朋友工作時段不同，但每周都預留周二晚飯，一起商量家務，也明說喜歡各自的興趣。有人只因興趣不同便說他們沒有交流。哪句較準確？

options.en: Different interests alone do not show they are running on different tracks with no shared time; they have a regular meal and discussion.
options.zh: 興趣不同本身不顯示他們完全各行各路、沒有共同時間；他們有固定晚飯及討論。

options.en: The Tuesday meal is still only a plan that the friends have not yet tried.
options.zh: 周二晚飯仍只是兩位朋友尚未試過的計劃。

options.en: Their working hours already coincide; only their leisure interests differ.
options.zh: 他們的工作時間已相同，只有閒暇興趣不同。

scene.explanationZh: 兩人工作時段不同，但每周已實際共進晚飯及討論；不能把共處移成尚未試行，或把工作時間說成已相同。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 running on different tracks 得出？

options.en: 各自生活方向或作息缺少配合或交集。
兩人一定互相不關心。
仍需具體情境說明在哪方面不同步。

contrast.explanationZh: 生活錯開不能直接證感情或關心程度。

dialogue.promptZh: 你想跟同住朋友多些交流，他卻提議買一套更大的留言板；你們已靠字條處理日常事。哪句回應最能表達你的需要？

options.en: We are running on different tracks, and I miss actually talking; could we find one evening for a meal rather than only leave more notes?
options.zh: 我們各有各的步調，我想真正談話；可否找一晚吃飯，不只多留字條？

options.en: A larger board should be our next step, without checking whether there is an evening we could share.
options.zh: 下一步應買較大板，不用查是否有一晚可共處。

options.en: Let us keep notes as our main contact and wait until the busy season ends before finding a shared evening.
options.zh: 先維持字條為主要聯絡，忙季完後才找共處晚上吧。

dialogue.explanationZh: 需要是共同交流時間，不只是留言容量；把討論一直延後也未回應想多談話的需要。

speaking.en: We have been running on different tracks lately, so I would like to agree on one time when we can talk properly.
speaking.zh: 最近我們各有各的步調，所以我想議一個可好好談話的時間。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說不同步的情況及想協調甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校兩個製作小組分別準備影片和展板，各自進度很好，但影片仍用舊題目、展板改了新題目，下周需一起展示。你想向兩組提出一次對照內容的會面，承認各自努力，避免只要求大家做快一點。用一至兩句英文協調。

examples.en: Both teams are working hard, but we are running on different tracks with two versions of the topic. Could we compare the film and display together before the joint presentation?
examples.zh: 兩隊都很努力，但因題目有兩版本，我們各行各路。共同展示前，可否一起對照影片及展板？

examples.en: We seem to be running on different tracks rather than falling behind. Let us agree on the shared topic and check where the two pieces need to connect.
examples.zh: 我們似乎各行各路，不是落後進度。先議共同題目，再核兩部分哪裏需接起來吧。

writing.selfCheckZh: 區分各自有進度及缺共同方向，提出對照與議題目；不以加速代內容協調，也不指責沒有努力。

takeaways.en: The two committees were running on different tracks until they compared the dates on their separate invitations.
takeaways.zh: 兩委員會各行各路，直到比較各自邀請上的日期。

takeaways.en: We ran on different tracks during the busy season, but a weekly call helped us keep some time together.
takeaways.zh: 忙季我們各有各的步調，但每周通話幫保留一些共處時間。

sources.sentence: The break let us press pause on that routine.

brief.meaningEn: Temporarily interrupt a named repeated pattern, with a later return possible.
brief.meaningZh: 暫時中斷已指明的重複安排，之後仍可能回復。
brief.grammar: press pause on that/the/our routine; pressed/pressing; pause is a media-control metaphor, and that routine needs an earlier description
brief.boundaryZh: 暫停不是永久取消，也不表示一個人停下便全隊不用履行已約責任；需說停哪部分及如何交接。
brief.misconceptionZh: 暫停不是永久取消，也不表示一個人停下便全隊不用履行已約責任；需說停哪部分及如何交接。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「暫時按停原有日常」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Conventional press-pause metaphor applied to a routine. The technology image is figurative; no physical button is required.

listening.en: Our evenings had become a cycle of checking work messages over dinner, so we decided to press pause on that routine during the weekend visit and return to the inbox on Monday.
listening.zh: 晚飯時查工作訊息已成每晚循環，所以周末探訪時我們決定暫停那種日常，周一再回覆收件匣。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 周末暫停晚飯查工作訊息的習慣，周一再處理。
兩人已決定永久離開原有工作，不再收訊息。
探訪期間仍每晚照舊查訊息，只改了吃飯地方。
兩人先結束周末探訪，才開始暫停查工作訊息。

listening.explanationZh: during visit/return Monday 說暫停指明循環，不是永久辭職、地點改變或把暫停移到探訪之後。

reply.promptEn: What pattern did you want to interrupt during the visit?
reply.promptZh: 探訪時，你們想中斷哪種模式？

options.en: We wanted to press pause on that routine of checking work messages over dinner.
options.zh: 我們想暫停晚飯查工作訊息那種日常。

options.en: We wanted the meal to be time together rather than another inbox session.
options.zh: 我們想吃飯是共處時間，不是再處理收件匣。

options.en: The repeated evening message checks were what we hoped to leave until Monday.
options.zh: 我們希望把每晚反覆查訊息留到周一。

options.en: We wanted a temporary change in how we spent dinner, not a permanent end to the jobs.
options.zh: 我們想暫改吃飯安排，不是永久終止工作。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物休假前把急件交給同伴，休假時不再每日更新進度表，回來再接手；有人以為暫停代表他已放棄這項工作。哪句較準確？

options.en: He pressed pause on the routine of daily updates during the break and arranged to resume it afterwards.
options.zh: 休息時他暫停每日更新的日常，並安排之後恢復。

options.en: The handover means he has permanently withdrawn from the project.
options.zh: 交接表示他已永久退出項目。

options.en: He continued writing the daily updates throughout the holiday before handing over.
options.zh: 他假期一直照寫每日更新，之後才交接。

scene.explanationZh: 暫停與交接可配合，回來接手顯示不是永久退出；需按實際順序。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 press pause on that routine 得出？

options.en: 暫時中斷前面已說的重複安排。
從此永久取消那項活動，不可能恢復。
仍需說明原有日常及暫停多久。

contrast.explanationZh: pause 保留之後可能再開始。

dialogue.promptZh: 你們原約周末不在晚飯看工作訊息，朋友提議仍把電腦開在桌上，只改吃飯時段。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: To press pause on that routine, I meant leaving the message checks until Monday, not moving them to a different dinner time.
options.zh: 暫停那種日常，是指把查訊息留周一，不是移到另一晚飯時間。

options.en: Let us keep the inbox open and count the later meal as the change we agreed.
options.zh: 保持收件匣開着，把吃晚一點當議好的改變吧。

options.en: We should choose a different restaurant before discussing whether to check the inbox.
options.zh: 先選另一餐廳，再談是否查收件匣吧。

dialogue.explanationZh: 原定暫停的是查訊息，不是用餐鐘點或地點。

speaking.en: We agreed to press pause on our routine of reviewing every message at night and spend one evening together without the inbox.
speaking.zh: 我們同意暫停每晚檢視所有訊息的日常，有一晚不看收件匣地共處。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說暫停哪個重複安排。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你帶閱讀小組，每次聚會都先用半小時比較完成頁數，近期有人說因此不敢談讀不懂的地方。你想向組員提議下次暫停那項例行比較，改為各帶一個問題，之後再商量是否保留改法。用一至兩句英文提出試行。

examples.en: Could we press pause on our routine of comparing page totals at the next meeting? I suggest bringing one question each, then deciding together whether the change helps us talk about the reading.
examples.zh: 下次聚會可否暫停比較頁數的日常？我建議各帶一個問題，再一起決定改動是否幫我們談閱讀。

examples.en: I would like to press pause on that routine of starting with page counts and try a question from each reader instead. We can review it afterwards rather than decide the format for every future meeting now.
examples.zh: 我想暫停以頁數開始那種日常，改試每位讀者一個問題。之後可檢視，不現在就定全部未來聚會形式。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指明暫停的是頁數比較，提出可試替代及之後共同檢視；不把一次暫停當所有未來安排已定。

takeaways.en: The team pressed pause on the routine of weekly rankings and tried a month of private feedback instead.
takeaways.zh: 團隊暫停每周排名的日常，改試一個月私下回饋。

takeaways.en: A shared breakfast let us press pause on our routine of leaving the house at separate times without speaking.
takeaways.zh: 一起早餐讓我們暫停各自出門、不說話的日常。

sources.sentence: A walk at lunchtime can be a small reset button.

brief.meaningEn: An experience that feels like a chance to start afresh or mentally reorganise after a difficult or repetitive period.
brief.meaningZh: 一段經歷令人感到有機會重新開始，或在困難、重複日子後整理思緒。
brief.grammar: a reset button / a small reset button as a metaphor for a brief mental restart; also press reset. Small signals limited relief, not a complete solution.
brief.boundaryZh: 重新開始的感覺不抹去已發生的事或自動完成未辦工作；需說當事人有何改變及下一步。
brief.misconceptionZh: 重新開始的感覺不抹去已發生的事或自動完成未辦工作；需說當事人有何改變及下一步。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「重新開始的重設鍵」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Technology-based restart metaphor. A reset button and pressing reset are related noun/action forms of the same image, not separate psychological processes.

listening.en: After several evenings arguing over the same draft, a day apart felt like a reset button for us; we returned ready to ask which parts we agreed on, though the ending still needed work.
listening.zh: 幾晚為同一草稿爭論後，分開一天像讓我們重新開始；回來願先問同意哪些部分，但結尾仍需修改。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 暫離後兩人較願重新談共同點，結尾仍未改完。
分開一天已令草稿結尾完成，兩人只需送印。
兩人回來後仍拒絕談任何共同點，沒有態度改變。
兩人只改了標點，未談過怎重新處理草稿。

listening.explanationZh: returned ready 是重新處理的意願；ending still needed work 保留實際未完部分。

reply.promptEn: What changed after the day apart?
reply.promptZh: 分開一天後，甚麼改變？

options.en: It felt like a reset button, and we were ready to look for points of agreement.
options.zh: 它像重新開始的重設鍵，我們願找共同點。

options.en: We came back less fixed on repeating the same argument.
options.zh: 回來後我們不再只想重複同一爭論。

options.en: The break gave us a fresh starting point for discussing the draft.
options.zh: 休息給我們討論草稿的新起點。

options.en: We could begin with what we shared, although the ending was still unfinished.
options.zh: 即使結尾仍未完，我們可先談共同部分。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物暫離工作枱後說心情放鬆了，卻仍用同一方式反覆爭論，自己也說未能重新看問題。你不想直接稱已重新開始。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: The break may have been pleasant, but this account does not yet show it acting like a reset button for the discussion.
options.zh: 休息可能愉快，但這敘述尚未顯示它讓討論重新開始。

options.en: A more pleasant mood alone confirms that the discussion now has a fresh approach.
options.zh: 較愉快心情本身，已確認討論有了新方式。

options.en: The person has stopped repeating the argument and started comparing the options calmly.
options.zh: 人物已不再重複爭論，開始平靜比較選項。

scene.explanationZh: 心情較好與處理方式重整需分清；已明說未能重新看，不能補成已開始比較。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 it felt like a reset button 得出？

options.en: 當事人覺得有重新開始或整理思緒的機會。
之前發生的事已被抹去，未完工作也已完成。
仍需說實際改變了甚麼及之後做甚麼。

contrast.explanationZh: 技術比喻不會替現實事件或未完工作按鍵消失。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友聽你說像按了重設鍵，就問是否可不用再改結尾。你想清楚說休息的作用。哪句最好？

options.en: It was a reset button for how we approached the draft, but we still need to rewrite the ending.
options.zh: 它讓我們重新處理草稿，但仍需重寫結尾。

options.en: We can treat the fresh feeling as the last revision and send the draft now.
options.zh: 可把新鮮感當最後修訂，現在送草稿。

options.en: I would reopen the same objections in their original order rather than begin with the points we now share.
options.zh: 我會按原次序重開相同反對，不先談我們現在的共同點。

dialogue.explanationZh: 承認重新處理的狀態，同時保留修改任務；不以心態代修訂，也不只重複原來爭論方式。

speaking.en: For me, the quiet morning was a reset button that helped me choose a first task instead of reopening every unfinished message.
speaking.zh: 對我，安靜早晨像重設鍵，幫我選首項工作，不再重開所有未完訊息。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說自己的新起點及實際改變。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學期開始，你想寫便條給自己，把第一個周末當重新整理讀書習慣的機會：先清出一個閱讀角，選一本真想讀的書，不要求一晚補完上學期所有欠讀。用一至兩句英文訂一個可實行起點。

examples.en: I want this weekend to be a reset button for my reading habits, starting with a clear corner and one book I actually want to read. I do not need to finish last term’s entire list before opening it.
examples.zh: 我想這周末成整理閱讀習慣的重設鍵，先清一個角落，選一本真想讀的書；打開前不需先讀完上學期整份清單。

examples.en: Making a reading corner feels like pressing reset: I can choose one book and give it a regular place in my week. The older list is still there, but it does not have to be tonight’s task.
examples.zh: 整理閱讀角像按重設鍵：我可選一本書，給它每周固定時間。舊清單仍在，但不一定今晚就做。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用重新安排環境及選書訂具體起點，承認舊清單仍在；不把重新開始當抹去過去或一晚全補完。

takeaways.en: The first rehearsal in the smaller room felt like a reset button: we began by listening to one another instead of arguing about the old performance.
takeaways.zh: 在小房首次排練像重設鍵：我們先聽彼此，不再爭舊演出。

takeaways.en: Before the next appointment, five minutes of quiet may serve as a small reset button.
takeaways.zh: 下一個預約前的五分鐘安靜時間，也許能讓人稍微重整心情。

sources.sentence: The trip was not picture-perfect, but it was fun.

brief.meaningEn: Looking completely beautiful or ideal, as if arranged for a perfect picture.
brief.meaningZh: 外觀看來完美漂亮，像精心安排的理想畫面。
brief.grammar: a picture-perfect village/day/setting; the hyphenated adjective evaluates appearance or an idealised overall scene, not necessarily every practical detail
brief.boundaryZh: 漂亮畫面不保證過程順利，也不能因有小缺點就說整段經歷沒有樂趣；需分外觀與實際體驗。
brief.misconceptionZh: 漂亮畫面不保證過程順利，也不能因有小缺點就說整段經歷沒有樂趣；需分外觀與實際體驗。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「看起來完美如畫」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: The harbour was picture-perfect in the evening light, but our visit was less smooth: we missed the last boat and had to wait for a bus, laughing about the wrong timetable.
listening.zh: 傍晚光線中海港完美如畫，但到訪過程不太順：我們錯過末班船，要等巴士，邊笑看錯時間表。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 海港外觀很美，旅程安排卻有錯失，兩人仍能笑着面對。
海港光線不適合拍照，但所有交通安排很順。
兩人按正確時間表搭到末班船，不需要巴士。
因海港好看，兩人沒有察覺末班船已離開。

listening.explanationZh: picture-perfect 評畫面，missed/wait 說實際不順；laughing 未把不順當全無樂趣。

reply.promptEn: How would you describe the visit to the harbour?
reply.promptZh: 你會怎形容海港之行？

options.en: The harbour was picture-perfect, even though we got the boat time wrong.
options.zh: 海港完美如畫，即使我們弄錯船期。

options.en: It looked wonderful, but the journey home involved an unexpected wait.
options.zh: 景色很好，但回程多了一次意外等候。

options.en: We had a beautiful evening view and a rather less organised departure.
options.zh: 我們看了漂亮傍晚景，離開安排就沒那麼妥。

options.en: It was not a flawless outing, though we could laugh about the mistake.
options.zh: 這不是毫無差錯的外出，不過我們能笑談錯誤。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 旅遊小冊選了一張整潔海灘照片，沒顯示鏡頭外正維修的入口；你需寫準確圖說，不以美景暗示所有設施正常。哪句較合適？

options.en: The photograph shows a picture-perfect beach, but visitors should check the current entrance arrangements.
options.zh: 照片顯示完美如畫的海灘，但訪客應查目前入口安排。

options.en: The photograph is sufficient evidence that the main entrance is open today.
options.zh: 照片已足以證明主要入口今天開放。

options.en: The picture already includes the entrance works as well as the shoreline, so no separate access note is needed.
options.zh: 照片已包括入口工程和海岸，所以不需另加通道說明。

scene.explanationZh: 照片只顯示選取的海灘畫面，沒包括入口工程，也未證今天通道狀態；美景與實際進入安排需分開。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 a picture-perfect setting 得出？

options.en: 場景看起來理想漂亮。
在這裏發生的每項活動都已順利安排。
實際體驗仍需按所發生的事描述。

contrast.explanationZh: 場景外觀不能替活動流程背書。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友因等巴士便說你不能再稱海港漂亮；你想分清景色與回程。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: The harbour was picture-perfect; that describes the view, not whether we caught the right bus.
options.zh: 海港完美如畫；那是在形容景色，不是在說我們有沒有搭上合適的巴士。

options.en: I took picture-perfect to mean that the whole outing, including the journey home, went smoothly.
options.zh: 我把 picture-perfect 理解成整趟外出，包括回程，都很順利。

options.en: I would check only whether the evening light will be similar before deciding to repeat that return route.
options.zh: 再用那條回程路線前，我只會查傍晚光線是否相似。

dialogue.explanationZh: 這裏說的是海港外觀；不能把它擴成回程順利，重排行程也需查交通而不只光線。

speaking.en: The room looked picture-perfect in the photograph, but I still wanted to know how the tables would work for our discussion.
speaking.zh: 房間照片看來完美漂亮，但我仍想知桌子怎配合我們討論。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分外觀與實際用途。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你要在校刊刊登自己練陶的首個杯子。照片上它不對稱，你原想不投稿，但老師問你學到甚麼；你想寫一小段，承認並非外觀完美，說杯柄反覆改過，願分享過程，不把不完美假稱成品已最實用。用一至兩句英文寫圖說。

examples.en: My first cup is not picture-perfect, but its uneven handle reminds me how many times I tried again. I would like to share the making as well as the finished photograph.
examples.zh: 我的首個杯子並非完美漂亮，但不平的杯柄讓我記起重試多少次。我想分享製作過程，也分享成品照片。

examples.en: This is not a picture-perfect cup; I kept changing the handle as I learned. The photograph can show where I have started, without pretending I have finished learning.
examples.zh: 這不是外觀完美的杯子；學習中我一直改杯柄。照片可展示我的起點，不裝作已學完。

writing.selfCheckZh: 承認實際外觀並指出製作學習過程，讓投稿有具體內容；不把不完美當沒有學習，也不聲稱功能已證。

takeaways.en: They chose the picture-perfect square for the opening photograph, then added a separate note about the steps at its entrance.
takeaways.zh: 他們選完美如畫廣場作開頭照片，再另加入口梯級說明。

takeaways.en: Our picnic was not picture-perfect after the rain, but we found shelter and enjoyed the conversation.
takeaways.zh: 下雨後野餐並非理想如畫，但我們找到遮蔽處，仍享受談話。

sources.sentence: The postcard view mattered less than the conversation.

sources.sentence: The viewpoint offers the postcard version of Hong Kong.

brief.meaningEn: An attractive scenic appearance, considered like the polished image on a postcard.
brief.meaningZh: 像明信片上經過選取、漂亮悅目的風景外觀。
brief.grammar: the postcard view / the postcard version of a place; postcard suggests a polished, picturesque representation, which may omit less attractive daily realities.
brief.boundaryZh: 描述景色吸引，不表示其他經歷不重要，也不自動說景色虛假；需看說話者怎比較所重視的事。
brief.misconceptionZh: 描述景色吸引，不表示其他經歷不重要，也不自動說景色虛假；需看說話者怎比較所重視的事。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「明信片般漂亮的景色」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Creative scenic-image frame, not a fixed dictionary idiom. Postcard evokes the selected attractive view; any contrast with conversation comes from the particular context.

listening.en: I enjoyed the postcard view across the lake, but the part I kept talking about afterwards was our long conversation with the woman who ran the ferry office.
listening.zh: 我喜歡湖對岸明信片般風景，但之後一直談起的是跟渡輪辦事處女職員的長談。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 說話者欣賞風景，但之後更常談一段人與人的交流。
說話者只見過明信片，沒有到湖邊。
渡輪職員只提供拍照位置，兩人沒談其他事情。
說話者回來後只談景色，沒有再提職員。

listening.explanationZh: enjoyed 景色與kept talking conversation可並存，並非景色假或未到訪。

reply.promptEn: What do you remember most about the visit to the lake?
reply.promptZh: 湖邊之行，你最記得甚麼？

options.en: The postcard view was beautiful, but the conversation at the ferry office stayed with me most.
options.zh: 明信片般風景很美，但渡輪辦事處的談話最令我記住。

options.en: I keep returning to what the woman told us during that long conversation.
options.zh: 我一直回想那位女職員長談中說的事。

options.en: The scenery mattered, though the human encounter became the part I spoke about later.
options.zh: 景色有其價值，但後來我談起的是那段相遇。

options.en: I remember the exchange at the office more vividly than the photograph I took.
options.zh: 比起拍的照片，我更清楚記得辦事處的交流。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 攝影者只受委託選風景照片，挑了一張山湖景；她沒有訪談，也沒聲稱照片代表居民全部生活。有人說選漂亮圖本身就是否認人的經歷。哪句較準確？

options.en: Choosing the postcard view for this scenic photograph does not itself deny that other experiences matter.
options.zh: 為風景照片選明信片般景色，本身不否認其他經歷重要。

options.en: The scenic brief also requires an account of the residents’ daily routines.
options.zh: 這項風景委託也要求交代居民每天的生活安排。

options.en: The photograph establishes that residents value the scenery more than their relationships.
options.zh: 照片確立居民重景色多於關係。

scene.explanationZh: 這次任務是選風景，不是聲稱涵蓋一切；不能反推居民價值判斷。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜只憑 the postcard view 得出？

options.en: 某景色被比作漂亮的明信片畫面。
這幅景色必定偽造，沒有真實地方。
可再問當事人還重視哪些經歷。

contrast.explanationZh: 明信片形容可指真實美景，不等於偽造。

dialogue.promptZh: 你想替湖邊文章加職員的聲音，朋友說有美景照便不用談那段交流。哪句回應最合適？

options.en: The postcard view shows one part of the visit; I would also like to include what our conversation helped us notice.
options.zh: 明信片般風景呈現到訪一部分；我也想加入談話幫我們留意的事。

options.en: I would leave the conversation out of this article and use the available space for more viewpoints around the lake.
options.zh: 我會不在這篇寫談話，把可用篇幅留給湖邊更多觀景角度。

options.en: I understood the photograph as the main reason the visit mattered, rather than what we learned in the conversation.
options.zh: 我以為照片才是到訪重要的主要原因，不是談話所學。

dialogue.explanationZh: 這篇想記到訪經驗，風景與談話可各有作用；不只增加觀景角度，也不把照片當最主要的收穫。

speaking.en: The postcard view attracted us to the village, but I wanted our account to include more than the scenery.
speaking.zh: 明信片般風景吸引我們到村莊，但我想敘述不只包括景色。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說外觀與其他到訪內容的關係。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你把十年前一張湖邊明信片與今天的照片並列。遠處山景仍在，但新渡輪碼頭改變了近岸畫面。你要寫圖說，說明明信片選取的美景仍可辨認，同時指出新照片多展示了甚麼，不由兩張圖判定居民生活變好或變壞。用一至兩句英文寫圖說。

examples.en: The postcard view of the hills is still recognisable, but the new ferry terminal changes the foreground. These pictures show two views of the shore, not a full account of how residents’ lives have changed.
examples.zh: 明信片般的遠山景仍可辨認，但新渡輪碼頭改變了前景。這兩張圖顯示岸邊的兩個畫面，不是居民生活如何改變的完整敘述。

examples.en: We can still find the postcard view in today’s photograph, alongside a terminal that was absent ten years ago. The comparison makes the changed foreground visible without deciding what that change means for everyone who lives here.
examples.zh: 今天的照片仍看得到明信片般風景，旁邊多了十年前沒有的碼頭。這項比較讓前景的變化清楚可見，但無法判定這項改變對每位居民的意義。

writing.selfCheckZh: 比較兩幅影像中仍可辨認與已改變的部分，讓選景範圍清楚；不把圖像差異直接推成人們生活好壞。

takeaways.en: The postcard view filled the first page, while the next page explained how the harbour’s working hours shaped local routines.
takeaways.zh: 明信片般風景佔首頁，下一頁則解海港工作時間怎影響當地作息。

takeaways.en: The brochure shows the postcard version of the fishing village; the interviews tell a fuller story.
takeaways.zh: 小冊子展現漁村明信片般的美麗一面；訪談則呈現更完整的故事。

lessons.titleZh: 把目光放在人與連繫上

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A good trip focuses on the human view.

brief.meaningEn: A perspective on a place or experience that attends to people and their connections, rather than scenery alone.
brief.meaningZh: 看待地方或經歷時，留意人的生活和連繫，不只景色。
brief.grammar: focus on/bring in the human view; in this travel context human contrasts people-centred attention with a postcard-like scenic view
brief.boundaryZh: 不是唯一正確觀點，也不表示可由一人代所有居民說話；需具體指出誰的經歷及敘述範圍。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是唯一正確觀點，也不表示可由一人代所有居民說話；需具體指出誰的經歷及敘述範圍。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「把目光放在人與連繫上」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Context-dependent creative contrast with scenic viewing, not a fixed idiom meaning one universal human opinion. The source supplies a people-and-connection emphasis.

listening.en: For our account of the ferry crossing, we wanted the human view as well as the coastline, so we asked a regular passenger how the service fitted around her weekly visits to her father.
listening.zh: 寫渡輪航程時，我們除海岸也想加入人的角度，所以問一位常客渡輪服務怎配合她每周探父親。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 作者加入一位乘客的生活與連繫經驗，也保留海岸。
作者用海岸照片推測乘客每周探誰，沒有詢問。
乘客被問的只是海岸拍攝光線，沒有日常經驗。
作者決定把這一位乘客的安排說成所有乘客的作息。

listening.explanationZh: asked a passenger/week visits 是具體人的經歷；as well as保留景色，沒聲稱人人相同。

reply.promptEn: Why did you ask the passenger about her weekly visits?
reply.promptZh: 你們為甚麼問乘客每周探訪的事？

options.en: We wanted the human view of the crossing, including how it helped her keep a family connection.
options.zh: 我們想寫航程中人的角度，包括它怎幫她維持家人連繫。

options.en: Her routine showed what the service meant in one person’s life.
options.zh: 她的作息顯示服務在一個人生活中的意思。

options.en: We wanted a lived experience alongside the coastline description.
options.zh: 我們想在海岸描述旁加入親身經驗。

options.en: The visits connected the journey with a relationship, not just a route on the water.
options.zh: 探訪把航程連到關係，不只是水上路線。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 渡輪展覽已有兩位乘客的敘述：一位珍惜每周探親，另一位因尾班船太早而常不能留下陪家人。編輯想只留愉快的一段，說那才是「人的角度」。哪句較準確？

options.en: Both accounts contribute to the human view, showing different ways the service affects family contact.
options.zh: 兩份敘述都提供人的角度，顯示服務如何以不同方式影響家人聯絡。

options.en: Only the positive account belongs in the human view; the difficulty with evening visits is merely a timetable detail.
options.zh: 只有正面敘述屬人的角度；晚上難以探訪只是時間表細節。

options.en: Both passengers are primarily asking for a later final sailing.
options.zh: 兩位乘客都主要在要求延後末班船。

scene.explanationZh: 兩人的家人聯絡經驗都有人本內容，可有正面與困難；只有一位提尾班船，不能替兩人定同一要求。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解最不符合這個旅遊語境中的 the human view？

options.en: 留意人的生活與連繫。
把一位受訪者的經驗當所有人的共同看法。
可與景色或路線描述並列，交代誰的經驗。

contrast.explanationZh: people-centred 不代表所有人相同或一人代表全部。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想用那位常客的探父經驗寫成「乘客都為家人乘船」，你們只訪問她一位。哪句較準確？

options.en: The human view here is her experience; we can name it clearly and ask others before broadening the claim.
options.zh: 這裏人的角度是她的經驗；可清楚指明，擴大說法前再問別人。

options.en: The same service means the same family purpose, so no more questions are needed.
options.zh: 同一服務就表示同一家人目的，不需再問。

options.en: I thought the human view required a dramatic personal story, rather than ordinary weekly visits.
options.zh: 我以為人的角度需戲劇化個人故事，不是平常每周探訪。

dialogue.explanationZh: 一位乘客的平常連繫也提供人的角度，但範圍仍是她的經驗，不能推同一服務人人同一目的。

speaking.en: I wanted the human view of the market, so I listened to how one stallholder described returning there each morning.
speaking.zh: 我想看市場中人的角度，所以聽一位攤主怎描述每天早上回來。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指明哪一位的經驗。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校刊製作新校舍專頁，你負責邀請同學投稿；不想只有建築照片或學校口號。你想邀每人自選一個具體地方及在那裏與人相處的經歷，也容許不同感受，不要求都寫成讚美。用一至兩句英文寫投稿邀請。

examples.en: Help us bring the human view into our school feature by choosing one place and telling us about an encounter there. Different feelings are welcome; your account does not have to praise the building.
examples.zh: 選一個地方、說一次在那裏與人相處的經驗，幫我們在校舍專頁加入人的角度。歡迎不同感受，不一定要讚美建築。

examples.en: For the human view of the new school, we would like your memory of sharing a particular space with someone. Please tell us whose experience it is rather than write on behalf of the whole year.
examples.zh: 要寫新校舍人的角度，我們想聽你與人共用某空間的回憶。請說明是誰的經驗，不代表全級說話。

writing.selfCheckZh: 邀一個具體人的相處經歷，保留投稿者的不同感受及範圍；不把人的角度等同統一讚美或代全級發言。

takeaways.en: The human view of the station emerged in a porter’s story about helping a family find their first train home.
takeaways.zh: 搬運工談幫一家人找到首班回家火車，呈現車站中人的角度。

takeaways.en: The human view mattered in her diary: she recorded the guide’s patient explanation alongside the mountain scene.
takeaways.zh: 她日記重視人的角度：在山景旁記下導遊耐心的解釋。

sources.sentence: The weekend helped bring people back to one another.
sources.expression: bring people back to one another

brief.meaningEn: Help people regain a sense of closeness or connection after distance or separation.
brief.meaningZh: 在人與人疏遠或分隔後，幫他們重新感到親近或連繫。
brief.grammar: a shared experience can bring people/us back to one another; brought/bringing; back describes restored connection, not necessarily returning to a physical place
brief.boundaryZh: 重新親近不等於爭議全解，也不一定要大家搬回同處；需說原本距離及重建交流的線索。
brief.misconceptionZh: 重新親近不等於爭議全解，也不一定要大家搬回同處；需說原本距離及重建交流的線索。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「讓人重新親近彼此」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: We had barely spoken during the busy month, but cooking together helped bring us back to one another: we began asking about the days we had missed, although we still needed to discuss the household rota.
listening.zh: 忙碌一月我們幾乎沒談話，但一起煮飯幫我們重新親近：開始問錯過的日子，雖然仍需談家務輪值。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 一起煮飯後兩人恢復關心彼近日生活，家務安排仍待談。
兩人回到以前住處，卻仍沒互問近況。
家務輪值已全部議定，所以兩人不用再談。
兩人只有分配食材，沒有恢復彼此交流。

listening.explanationZh: asking about missed days 指關係重新交流，not physicalmove；still needed 保留未談事項。

reply.promptEn: What did cooking together change between you?
reply.promptZh: 一起煮飯改變了你們之間甚麼？

options.en: It helped bring us back to one another after a month of hardly talking.
options.zh: 幾乎沒談話一月後，它幫我們重新親近彼此。

options.en: We started taking an interest in what the other person had been doing.
options.zh: 我們開始留意對方最近做甚麼。

options.en: The shared task made room for a conversation we had been missing.
options.zh: 一起工作給缺少的談話留了空間。

options.en: We felt connected again, even though the rota still needed discussion.
options.zh: 即使輪值仍需談，我們重新感到有連繫。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 兄妹仍住不同城市，過去只互傳節日問候；最近每周通話、互問實際近況。朋友說沒搬近便不能算重新親近。哪句較準確？

options.en: The calls have brought them back to one another emotionally, although they still live in different cities.
options.zh: 即使仍住不同城市，通話已讓他們在情感上重新親近。

options.en: The calls still contain only occasional holiday greetings, rather than discussion of their ordinary weeks.
options.zh: 通話仍只有偶爾節日問候，不是談各自平常的一周。

options.en: Regular calls are a future proposal; the siblings have not yet begun that pattern of contact.
options.zh: 定期通話是未來提議，兄妹尚未開始這種聯絡。

scene.explanationZh: 題目已說最近每周通話並互問近況，較以往節日問候更有交流；不是只有未來計劃，也不由分開住否定連繫。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 brought people back to one another 得出？

options.en: 原有距離之後，人們重新感到連繫。
人們之間每個未解問題都已處理完。
仍可有不同住處或需要另談的安排。

contrast.explanationZh: 重新親近與所有議題已解不是同一件事。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說「晚飯談得好了，就不需談家務輪值」，但你仍想保留共處也處理安排。哪句最好？

options.en: Cooking helped bring us back to one another; I would like to keep that connection while finding a fair way to share the chores.
options.zh: 煮飯幫我們重新親近；我想保留連繫，同時找公平分家務的方法。

options.en: Let us keep the old rota without asking whether the hours still fit us.
options.zh: 先不問時數是否仍合適，照留舊輪值吧。

options.en: We should discuss only the list of chores and stop asking about each other’s days.
options.zh: 應只談家務清單，不再問彼此近況。

dialogue.explanationZh: 共同感受及實際安排可並行，不以一項代另一項，也不因要處理家務就取消交流。

speaking.en: The shared afternoon brought us back to one another, giving us time to listen before returning to the question we still disagreed about.
speaking.zh: 共處一下午讓我們重新親近，有時間先聽，再回到仍有分歧的問題。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分關係重新連繫與分歧已解。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替重聚後的舊同學群組寫訊息。聚會讓大家重新聽到彼此近況，你不想熱鬧過一晚便再斷聯，也不想強迫人人固定出席。你想感謝重聚，邀自願每月分享一件近事或只閱讀。用一至兩句英文發出邀請。

examples.en: The reunion helped bring us back to one another, and I would like to give that contact a little space beyond one evening. Would anyone enjoy an optional monthly update, with no pressure to reply each time?
examples.zh: 重聚幫我們重新親近，我想讓連繫不只一晚。大家想試自願每月更新嗎，不需每次回覆？

examples.en: Hearing your news brought us back to one another after so long apart. Perhaps we could share one recent event each month, while leaving everyone free to read quietly or join in when they wish.
examples.zh: 分隔很久後，聽你們近況讓我們重新親近。也許每月分享一件近事，各人仍可安靜閱讀或想參與時加入。

writing.selfCheckZh: 感謝重新交流並提出自願持續方法，讓選擇清楚；不聲稱所有關係已回復原樣或要求每人固定回覆。

takeaways.en: Reading their old letters brought them back to one another and started a conversation about the years they had spent apart.
takeaways.zh: 讀舊信讓他們重新親近，開始談分隔的歲月。

takeaways.en: The neighbourhood meal helped bring people back to one another after months of passing without stopping to talk.
takeaways.zh: 幾月都匆匆走過、不停下談話後，鄰里聚餐幫大家重新親近。

sources.sentence: I try not to shop on a whim when prices are high.

brief.meaningEn: Because of a sudden passing wish rather than a considered reason; it can modify changing plans, buying something, or another spontaneous action.
brief.meaningZh: 因突然、短暫的念頭而行動，而非經仔細考慮；可指改計劃、購物或其他行動。
brief.grammar: On a whim is an adverbial phrase modifying an action: change course on a whim, buy something on a whim, or did not act on a whim. It does not itself mean the choice was harmful.
brief.register: Neutral conversational idiom; a traveller may say it to a friend about a spontaneous detour, while a shopper may deny that a purchase was impulsive.
brief.boundaryZh: 一時興起不必然好或壞，但與因新證據、限制而改計劃不同；涉及他人時仍需商量。
brief.misconceptionZh: 一時興起不必然好或壞，但與因新證據、限制而改計劃不同；涉及他人時仍需商量。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「一時興起就改變計劃」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: Travelling alone, I could change course on a whim: a song from an open doorway made me leave the planned square and spend the afternoon listening nearby, with no companion’s plans to rearrange.
listening.zh: 獨遊時，我可一時興起改計劃：敞門傳出的歌令我離開原定廣場，下午改在附近聽歌，不需重排旅伴安排。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 說話者因當下聽到歌的興趣，臨時改了自己下午計劃。
廣場被確認關閉，所以說話者按事先備案改路。
旅伴不同意廣場行程，兩人商量後另選活動。
說話者早已預訂下午聽歌，原沒有廣場計劃。

listening.explanationZh: a song made me 與 planned square 對比，顯示當下念頭；沒有同伴需協調，不是所有改計劃都如此。

reply.promptEn: Why did you leave the plan for the square?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼改了去廣場的計劃？

options.en: I could change course on a whim, and the music caught my interest.
options.zh: 我可一時興起改計劃，音樂又吸引了我。

options.en: I suddenly wanted to stay and listen to the song.
options.zh: 我突然想留下聽那首歌。

options.en: The idea came from hearing the music, not from a problem with the square.
options.zh: 念頭來自聽到音樂，不是廣場出了問題。

options.en: I was on my own and chose to follow a passing interest that afternoon.
options.zh: 我自己一人，選擇那下午跟隨一時興趣。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 小組原訂戶外展，收到大雨通知後查室內場地、通知所有參加者，再改地點；沒有臨時個人喜好的描述。哪句最不準確？

options.en: The team changed course on a whim, without a reason to reconsider the outdoor plan.
options.zh: 團隊一時興起改計劃，沒有理由重看戶外安排。

options.en: The team revised its plan after new information and discussion.
options.zh: 團隊在新資料及討論後修改計劃。

options.en: The change responded to an expected constraint rather than a passing wish.
options.zh: 改動回應預期限制，不是短暫念頭。

scene.explanationZh: 新天氣資料、核場地及通知屬有理由的調整，不是只因一時興起。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 change course on a whim 得出？

options.en: 一個短暫念頭促成改變計劃。
每次有新證據而調整計劃都屬這種情況。
要看改動原因，才能分一時興起與經考慮調整。

contrast.explanationZh: 改變本身不足以說whim，需有當下念頭原因。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想在一起帶隊時臨時改目的地，沒問另一位領隊；他說獨遊時都可如此。哪句回應最合適？

options.en: You can change course on a whim when your own plans are at stake, but we need to check the shared arrangements before changing this group’s route.
options.zh: 只有自己安排時可一時興起改計劃，但改這組路線前，需先核共同安排。

options.en: Let us announce the new destination first and ask the other leader after the group arrives.
options.zh: 先宣布新目的地，到達後再問另一領隊吧。

options.en: I would check whether I can manage the new route, rather than whether it fits the group’s arrangements and the other leader’s responsibilities.
options.zh: 我只會查自己能否走新路線，不查是否配合全組安排及另一領隊的責任。

dialogue.explanationZh: 帶隊涉及共同責任，需先協調全組安排；不能先宣布後問，也不只核自己的方便。

speaking.en: I sometimes change course on a whim when I am exploring alone, but shared plans call for a conversation first.
speaking.zh: 獨自探索時我有時一時興起改計劃，但共同安排需先談。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分個人選擇及共同安排。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們的小刊封面已排好，朋友臨時喜歡另一張圖，想今晚全部換掉；你也願聽新構想，但想知道是否值得重新取得授權及延後送印。你想邀他先說改圖目的，不把新鮮感當充分理由，也不一概拒改。用一至兩句英文回覆。

examples.en: Before we change course on a whim, could you explain what the new image would add to the cover? I am open to it, but we should weigh that benefit against getting permission again and delaying the printing.
examples.zh: 一時興起改計劃前，可否解新圖會為封面加甚麼？我願考慮，但需比較好處與重取授權、延遲印刷。

examples.en: I do not want us to change course on a whim just because another picture feels new tonight. Let us compare its purpose with the current cover before deciding whether the extra work is worthwhile.
examples.zh: 我不想只因今晚另一圖感覺新鮮，就一時興起改計劃。先比它與現封面的目的，再定額外工作是否值得。

writing.selfCheckZh: 邀具體改動目的及比較代價，不只因新鮮就推翻已排安排，也不拒絕所有有理由的改動。

takeaways.en: She changed course on a whim after seeing a pottery display and spent her free hour talking to the maker.
takeaways.zh: 看到陶藝展示後，她一時興起改計劃，用空閒一小時跟製作者談話。

takeaways.en: Maya did not sign up for the night course on a whim: she compared the timetable and costs first.
takeaways.zh: Maya 報讀夜校課程並非一時興起：她先比較了時間表和費用。

sources.sentence: The solo hike felt like breathing with your full lungs.

brief.meaningEn: Feeling unusually free or unconstrained, expressed through an image of breathing fully.
brief.meaningZh: 透過充分呼吸的畫面，表達格外自由、不受束縛的感受。
brief.grammar: it felt like breathing with my/your full lungs; a simile for personal freedom, with the possessive agreeing with the person describing the experience
brief.boundaryZh: 這裏是當事人的自由感，不是肺功能測量或人人獨處必有同樣感受；需說少了哪種束縛。
brief.misconceptionZh: 這裏是當事人的自由感，不是肺功能測量或人人獨處必有同樣感受；需說少了哪種束縛。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「彷彿終於能自在呼吸」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Creative breathing image in the source, not a fixed medical or psychological term. Explain the personal sense of freedom from the context.

listening.en: Choosing my own afternoon felt like breathing with my full lungs after a week of following everyone else’s timetable; I could stop at the small gallery without asking the group to change its plans.
listening.zh: 跟了別人時間表一周後，自己選下午安排像終能自在呼吸；我可在小畫廊停留，不需請全組改計劃。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 說話者因可自己選擇及停留，感到較自由。
說話者量度了呼吸，證實肺部有某種改變。
說話者仍需每次停留都等全組同意，沒有選擇改變。
全組已決定一起進畫廊，所以說話者照跟原時間表。

listening.explanationZh: own afternoon/without asking group 指少了行程束縛，不是身體測量。

reply.promptEn: Why did the afternoon feel so freeing?
reply.promptZh: 那下午為甚麼令你感到自由？

options.en: It felt like breathing with my full lungs because I could choose where to stop.
options.zh: 它像終能自在呼吸，因我可自己選在哪停。

options.en: I did not have to fit each small decision into the group’s timetable.
options.zh: 每個小決定都不用配合全組時間表。

options.en: For a while I could follow my own interest without rearranging everyone else’s day.
options.zh: 一段時間內，我可跟自己興趣，不需重排每人一天。

options.en: The gallery could be my choice for the afternoon rather than a proposal I needed others to accept.
options.zh: 畫廊可成自己下午的選擇，不是需別人接受的提案。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物獨遊時反而一直擔心自己選錯，也說跟人討論較自在；朋友只因她獨自出門便套用充分呼吸的自由感。哪句較謹慎？

options.en: Her account does not describe the trip as breathing with her full lungs; she says the decisions felt more constraining on her own.
options.zh: 她的敘述沒把旅程形容為自在呼吸；她說自己決定反而更受束縛。

options.en: Being alone is enough to establish that she felt freer at each decision.
options.zh: 獨處已足以確立她每個決定都更自由。

options.en: She has reported enjoying the freedom of choosing without discussion.
options.zh: 她已說自己享受不用討論就選的自由。

scene.explanationZh: 比喻需按她的感受，不能由獨遊形式替她定自由；她明說較想討論。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由這個充分呼吸的比喻得出？

options.en: 當事人在這個情境感到較少束縛。
它已證明某種旅行改善了肺部機能。
需看實際少了哪種限制，不能由形式替他人定感受。

contrast.explanationZh: 個人自由感的比喻不是身體成效證明。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「你這樣形容，是要我也改獨遊嗎？」你只想表達自己這下午的感受。哪句最好？

options.en: It felt like breathing with my full lungs for me that afternoon; I would still want to ask what kind of trip suits you.
options.zh: 那下午對我像終能自在呼吸；我仍想先問哪種旅行適合你。

options.en: I would take my reaction as a reason for you to choose the same arrangement before we discuss your preferences.
options.zh: 我會把我的反應當你也應選相同安排的理由，先不用談你喜好。

options.en: I understood the feeling as evidence that the gallery itself is less crowded than the other places.
options.zh: 我把那感受理解為畫廊本身比其他地方少人的證據。

dialogue.explanationZh: 自己行程自由不定他人偏好，也不等於場地人數資料。

speaking.en: Writing without a fixed topic felt like breathing with my full lungs after weeks of fitting every sentence into the same format.
speaking.zh: 幾周每句都需配同一格式後，不限題目寫作像終能自在呼吸。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說哪種限制少了。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫信給從前的寫作伙伴，第一次可用自己熟悉的方言寫一段家鄉故事，不需逐句改成別人指定的語氣。你想形容創作上的自由，也承認之後仍想請讀者問不清楚的地方，不把自由當不用修改。用一至兩句英文分享。

examples.en: Writing the village story in my own voice felt like breathing with my full lungs. I could finally choose the words I knew, though I still want readers to tell me where the story needs a clearer explanation.
examples.zh: 用自己的聲音寫村莊故事，像終能自在呼吸。我終可選熟悉的字，但仍想讀者告訴我哪裏需解清楚。

examples.en: It was like breathing with my full lungs to stop reshaping every line into someone else’s tone. I would like to keep that freedom while listening to questions that could help me revise the story.
examples.zh: 不用再把每句改成別人的語氣，像終能自在呼吸。我想保留自由，也聽可幫我修改故事的問題。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用創作聲音選擇表達自己的自由感，仍願聽具體問題修訂；不把比喻當身體變化或拒絕全部回應。

takeaways.en: An afternoon with no expected performance felt like breathing with her full lungs; she could paint simply because she wanted to.
takeaways.zh: 一下午不需交出表現，對她像終能自在呼吸；可只因自己想而畫。

takeaways.en: For him, choosing a small project of his own was like breathing with his full lungs after months of completing only assigned work.
takeaways.zh: 幾月只做指定工作後，自己選一個小項目，對他像終能自在呼吸。

sources.sentence: They wanted to travel on their own terms.

brief.meaningEn: In a way or under conditions that the person chooses or accepts for themselves.
brief.meaningZh: 按當事人自行選擇或接受的方式和條件行事。
brief.grammar: travel/work/participate on my/your/their own terms; the possessive identifies whose choices or conditions matter
brief.boundaryZh: 自主不等於可單方面取消已同意責任，或所有人必接受自己的條件；需分清個人選擇與共同約定。
brief.misconceptionZh: 自主不等於可單方面取消已同意責任，或所有人必接受自己的條件；需分清個人選擇與共同約定。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「按自己選擇的條件行事」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: Nora wanted to join the exhibition on her own terms: she was happy to show two drawings, but asked not to give a public speech, and waited for the organisers to confirm that arrangement.
listening.zh: Nora 想按自己接受的方式參展：願展兩幅畫，但要求不公開演講，並等主辦者確認這安排。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: Nora 提出願接受的參與條件，安排仍待主辦者確認。
Nora 已答應演講，只想讓主辦者替她選內容。
主辦者已確認每位參展者都毋須演講。
Nora 決定不給畫，也不再參與展覽。

listening.explanationZh: happy to show/asked not speech 指她的條件；waited confirm 保留雙方安排未定。

reply.promptEn: What did Nora want from the exhibition arrangement?
reply.promptZh: Nora 希望參展安排怎樣？

options.en: She wanted to participate on her own terms, with drawings but no public speech if the organisers agreed.
options.zh: 若主辦者同意，她想按自己接受的方式參與，展畫但不演講。

options.en: She hoped her work could be included without a speaking role she did not want.
options.zh: 她希望作品可入展，不需不想要的演說角色。

options.en: Showing two drawings was acceptable to her, while a public speech was not.
options.zh: 展兩畫她可接受，公開演講則不。

options.en: She wanted the organisers to consider a particular boundary before confirming her place.
options.zh: 確認位置前，她想主辦者考慮一項具體界限。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物已答應跟組員共同決定展品，後來說按自己條件做事便可不問別人、直接改掉全組清單。哪句較準確？

options.en: Working on his own terms does not by itself cancel the shared decision process he agreed to.
options.zh: 按自己條件工作，本身不取消他已同意的共同決策程序。

options.en: His preference is enough to establish that the group has agreed to the new list.
options.zh: 他的偏好已足以確立小組同意新清單。

options.en: The earlier agreement concerned only his own items, not a shared selection.
options.zh: 先前約定只關他的物件，不是共同選材。

scene.explanationZh: 個人界限可商量，但不能用它改寫已同意的共同程序或補出同意。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 on their own terms 得出？

options.en: 當事人重視自己選擇或接受的條件。
其他人已必須接受所有條件，毋須商量。
涉及共同安排時仍可需雙方確認。

contrast.explanationZh: 表達自主選擇，不給對他人的單方面決定權。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說 Nora 不想演講，便應勸她整個展覽都退出；她其實想展畫。哪句回應最好？

options.en: She wants to join on her own terms, so let us ask whether the drawings can be included without a speech before assuming she must withdraw.
options.zh: 她想按自己接受方式參與，所以先問可否只展畫，不先假定需退出。

options.en: I would tell her that showing the drawings should come with whatever speaking role the organisers assign.
options.zh: 我會告訴她，展畫就應接受主辦者指定的演說角色。

options.en: I would focus on choosing a shorter speech for her before asking whether she wants any speaking part.
options.zh: 我會先替她選較短演講，不先問是否想有演說部分。

dialogue.explanationZh: 先商量實際可接受條件，不把參與全部綁演講，也不在界限未問前替她調長短。

speaking.en: I would like to return to the project on my own terms, with a role I can agree to rather than the one others assume I want.
speaking.zh: 我想按自己接受條件重返項目，選一個自己可同意的角色，不是別人以為我想要的。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說當事人接受的參與條件。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你為祖父做相簿，他願說一些舊照片故事，但想自己選哪些只留家中、哪些可展示。你想寫一小段相簿前言，承認他有權按自己接受的方式分享，說明選材界限，不代他承諾日後全部公開。用一至兩句英文寫前言。

examples.en: My grandfather has shared these memories on his own terms, choosing which stories belong in this album and which remain within the family. This selection reflects those choices, not permission to publish everything he told us.
examples.zh: 祖父按自己接受的方式分享回憶，選哪些故事入相簿、哪些留家中。這份選材反映他的選擇，不是可公開他全部說話的許可。

examples.en: He wanted to tell the story on his own terms, with some photographs kept for family viewing only. We have followed that boundary in making the album and will ask again before sharing it more widely.
examples.zh: 他想按自己接受方式說故事，有些照片只供家人看。我們製作相簿時依這界限，廣泛分享前會再問。

writing.selfCheckZh: 交代由祖父選分享範圍，按已同意界限製作相簿；不把參與當日後全部公開許可，也不替他預定答案。

takeaways.en: She returned to the choir on her own terms, attending rehearsals before deciding whether to take part in the concert.
takeaways.zh: 她按自己接受方式回合唱團，先排練，再定是否參加音樂會。

takeaways.en: They wanted to explore the town on their own terms, so they agreed which parts of the group programme were optional before booking.
takeaways.zh: 他們想按自己選擇探索城鎮，所以訂前議好團體節目哪些可自選。

sources.sentence: A quiet trip can be a conversation with yourself.

brief.meaningEn: A period of self-reflection in which someone considers their own feelings, questions or choices.
brief.meaningZh: 反思自己的感受、問題或選擇，彷彿與自己交談的一段時間。
brief.grammar: a walk/trip/journal becomes a conversation with yourself; reflexive pronoun agrees with the person reflecting; the dialogue can be silent
brief.boundaryZh: 反思不一定出聲，也不保證立即找到答案；需指出自己在想哪個問題，不能替他人定想法。
brief.misconceptionZh: 反思不一定出聲，也不保證立即找到答案；需指出自己在想哪個問題，不能替他人定想法。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「與自己進行一場對話」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Creative self-dialogue metaphor, not a claim of an actual second speaker or a guaranteed self-help method.

listening.en: The long train ride became a conversation with myself about why I kept accepting work I no longer enjoyed; I wrote down two questions, without deciding the answer before I reached home.
listening.zh: 長途火車變成與自己的一場對話，想為何一直接已不喜歡的工作；回家前我寫下兩問題，未先定答案。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 旅途中說話者反思自己的選擇，留下問題，未有定案。
另一位乘客替說話者選好了回家後的工作。
說話者一直出聲重述行程，沒有考慮自己的選擇。
兩個問題已在上車前全部解決，火車只用來抄答案。

listening.explanationZh: about why/wrote questions 指自我反思；without deciding 保留未定，無需另一說話者。

reply.promptEn: What were you doing during the train ride?
reply.promptZh: 火車上你在做甚麼？

options.en: It became a conversation with myself about the work I kept accepting.
options.zh: 它變成與自己的對話，想一直接的工作。

options.en: I was trying to understand a pattern in my own choices.
options.zh: 我想理解自己選擇中的一種模式。

options.en: I wrote questions about what I enjoyed and what I had simply kept doing.
options.zh: 我寫自己享受甚麼、哪些只是一直照做的問題。

options.en: I used the quiet time to reflect rather than rush to a decision.
options.zh: 我用安靜時間反思，不急定案。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 你只看見故事人物在車站安靜望窗，沒聽到他的想法，也沒看到筆記；朋友想直接寫他正在反思要不要離職。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: The silence alone does not establish a conversation with himself about leaving his job.
options.zh: 單憑沉默，不能確立他正與自己對話、反思是否離職。

options.en: His quiet appearance is enough to identify leaving his job as the question he is considering.
options.zh: 他安靜的樣子，已足以認定他正在考慮是否離職。

options.en: His stillness shows that he is reviewing a decision already made rather than considering options.
options.zh: 他靜坐不動，顯示他正在回想已作決定，而不是考慮選項。

scene.explanationZh: 外在安靜可以與反思並存，但未給具體內容；不能由樣子判定正在想離職，或已作出決定。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 a conversation with yourself 得出？

options.en: 當事人反思自己的問題或感受。
一定有人聽見當事人大聲說話。
可以尚未有答案，先把問題看清。

contrast.explanationZh: 比喻可指無聲反思，不要求公開出聲。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問你火車上是否已定離職，你其實只寫下兩個問題。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: It was a conversation with myself, not a final decision; I want to understand the questions before choosing what to do.
options.zh: 那是與自己的對話，不是定案；我想先理解問題，再選做甚麼。

options.en: I will take the questions as a decision and start telling people I am leaving.
options.zh: 我會把這些問題當成決定，開始告訴別人我要離開。

options.en: I thought an unresolved conversation with myself was just indecision, so it would be better to put the questions away.
options.zh: 我以為與自己對話卻未有答案，只是優柔寡斷，所以最好把問題放下。

dialogue.explanationZh: 說話者仍在理解自己的問題，未作離職決定；反思未完仍可有用途，不需宣布結果或因此放棄提問。

speaking.en: Keeping the notebook became a conversation with myself about what I valued, rather than a list of answers I had to produce for someone else.
speaking.zh: 寫筆記變成與自己的對話，想自己重視甚麼，不是交給別人的答案清單。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說正在反思的具體問題。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你準備寫一段日記導言，先前每天只列完成多少事，現在想每周選一件小事，問自己為何在意、下次想怎回應。這是私下反思，不需給同學看，也不要求當晚想通。用一至兩句英文寫給自己。

examples.en: I want this diary to be a conversation with myself, not another tally of completed tasks. Each week I will choose one small moment and ask why it mattered, leaving room to return to the question later.
examples.zh: 我想日記是與自己的對話，不是另一份完成工作計數。每周選一小刻，問它為何重要，留空間之後再看問題。

examples.en: A weekly page could become a conversation with myself about the choices hidden inside ordinary days. I can ask how I would respond next time without requiring a finished answer tonight.
examples.zh: 每周一頁可成與自己的對話，想平常日子裏的選擇。我可問下次想怎回應，不要求今晚有完整答案。

writing.selfCheckZh: 訂一個具體自我提問方法及可再看的問題，保留私人與未定空間；不把日記當向他人交代全部私事或立即作決定。

takeaways.en: The solo walk became a conversation with herself about what she missed, without giving her an immediate plan.
takeaways.zh: 獨自散步成了與自己的對話，想念甚麼，但沒立即給她計劃。

takeaways.en: He described the sketchbook as a conversation with himself, returning to one question through different drawings.
takeaways.zh: 他把畫簿形容為與自己的對話，透過不同畫再看同一問題。

sources.sentence: She travelled alone to find inner space.

brief.meaningEn: Mental or emotional room to reflect, feel calm or attend to one’s own thoughts.
brief.meaningZh: 心裏可反思、感到安靜或留意自己想法的餘地。
brief.grammar: find/need/create inner space; space is psychological room, not necessarily an empty physical room; clarify what competing demands are set aside
brief.boundaryZh: 內心餘地不由房間大小或是否獨處自動證明，也不保證所有煩惱已解；需按當事人感受。
brief.misconceptionZh: 內心餘地不由房間大小或是否獨處自動證明，也不保證所有煩惱已解；需按當事人感受。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「內心安靜思考的空間」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: Leaving the group chat alone for an hour gave me some inner space to notice what I wanted from the visit, instead of answering each suggestion before I had considered it.
listening.zh: 暫離群聊一小時，給我心裏餘地去想自己想從探訪得到甚麼，不再未考慮便回每個建議。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 暫不回訊息讓說話者較能留意自己想法。
說話者搬進更大房間，才找到放行李的位置。
說話者已同意每項建議，所以不需考慮自己想法。
一小時內說話者繼續立即回每訊息，未有暫停。

listening.explanationZh: notice what I wanted 與不立即回答說思考餘地，不是物理收納。

reply.promptEn: What did the hour away from the chat give you?
reply.promptZh: 暫離聊天一小時，給你甚麼？

options.en: It gave me inner space to work out what I actually wanted.
options.zh: 它給我心裏餘地，想自己真正想要甚麼。

options.en: I could consider the suggestions before responding to them.
options.zh: 我可先考慮建議，再回應。

options.en: There was room to hear my own preferences among the messages.
options.zh: 眾多訊息之間，我有餘地聽自己喜好。

options.en: The pause helped me separate my wishes from the pressure to answer quickly.
options.zh: 暫停幫我分開自己願望與快回覆的壓力。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物在熱鬧宿舍戴上耳機，寫幾行私人筆記後說終有心裏餘地想清自己要問的問題；朋友認為沒有空房就不可能。哪句較準確？

options.en: She has described finding inner space within a shared room, not acquiring a separate physical room.
options.zh: 她描述在共用房內找到心裏餘地，不是取得另一間實體房。

options.en: The shared room proves that she could not reflect while writing the notes.
options.zh: 共用房證明她寫筆記時不能反思。

options.en: She postponed thinking about the questions until she had found a separate room.
options.zh: 她留待找到另一房間後，才開始想那些問題。

scene.explanationZh: 她在共用房寫筆記時已描述反思餘地，不需先另獲房間，也不是之後才開始想。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 finding inner space 得出？

options.en: 有心裏餘地留意自己的想法。
已經取得一間更大或獨立的房間。
需看哪些要求暫放下，以及當事人感受。

contrast.explanationZh: 心理空間的比喻不報告實體房間變動。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想先替你填滿所有探訪時段，你說想留時間想自己的需要。他問是否你不想見任何人。哪句回應最好？

options.en: I want some inner space to choose, not an end to seeing people; could we leave an hour unplanned before confirming the visits?
options.zh: 我想有心裏餘地選擇，不是不要見人；確認探訪前，可否先留一小時不排？

options.en: I would accept the whole schedule now and decide what I want only after every visit is booked.
options.zh: 我會現在接受全表，待每次探訪都訂好後才想自己想甚麼。

options.en: I thought wanting time to reflect meant there was no place for shared plans at all.
options.zh: 我以為想有時間反思，就表示完全不能有共同安排。

dialogue.explanationZh: 留反思時間可與共處並存，先想再承諾，不把內心餘地當拒絕全部人。

speaking.en: I need a little inner space to think about the invitation before the conversation turns into a confirmed plan.
speaking.zh: 談話變成確定計劃前，我需要一點心裏餘地想這邀請。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說想在承諾前留甚麼餘地。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你照寫朋友建議的畢業感言，發現每句都像別人的期望，未說自己最珍惜甚麼。你想向合作者提議先各自安靜寫五分鐘、再自願分享一個片段，讓不同聲音進入共同稿，不要求交出私人日記。用一至兩句英文建議流程。

examples.en: Could we give ourselves some inner space before combining everyone’s ideas into the farewell speech? Five minutes of private notes, followed by an optional memory to share, might help us hear what each person values.
examples.zh: 合成畢業感言前，可否先給自己心裏餘地？先私寫五分鐘，再自願分享一段回憶，也許可幫聽各人重視甚麼。

examples.en: I would like some inner space to find my own words before we edit the shared speech. Perhaps we could write separately first and each choose one part we are comfortable bringing to the group.
examples.zh: 改共同感言前，我想有心裏餘地找自己的說話。也許先分開寫，再各選一部分願帶到小組。

writing.selfCheckZh: 留具體私人反思時段，再自選可分享片段，讓共同稿有不同聲音；不預先假定每人都想公開筆記或保證流程必有同一效果。

takeaways.en: A few minutes with the window open gave her inner space to consider the question before replying.
takeaways.zh: 開窗幾分鐘，給她心裏餘地先想問題再回覆。

takeaways.en: He wanted inner space during the journey, so he left the first page of his notebook for questions rather than a finished plan.
takeaways.zh: 旅途中他想有心裏餘地，所以筆記首頁留給問題，不是完整計劃。

lessons.titleEn: go from being ... to something people can shape
lessons.titleZh: 從偶爾大事變成可參與塑造

target.pattern: \b(?:go(?:es|ing)?|went|gone) from being\b.{1,120}\bto something people can shape\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Travel has gone from being a big occasional event to something people can shape.
sources.expression: gone from being a big occasional event to something people can shape

brief.meaningEn: Change from a previously fixed or occasional experience into one whose form people can influence.
brief.meaningZh: 由以往較固定或偶爾舉行的經驗，變成參與者可影響其形式的事。
brief.grammar: has gone from being X to something people can shape; from names the earlier state and to introduces the later one; shape means influence its form
brief.boundaryZh: 需有前後狀態及可影響哪些部分的證據，不表示任何人已可控制所有條件，也不概括所有旅行都一樣變。
brief.misconceptionZh: 需有前後狀態及可影響哪些部分的證據，不表示任何人已可控制所有條件，也不概括所有旅行都一樣變。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「從偶爾大事變成可參與塑造」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Productive from/to transformation frame with figurative shape, not a fixed whole idiom. The useful contrast is a changed relationship between a formerly set event and participant choice.

listening.en: Our club trip has gone from being a yearly coach outing to something people can shape: members now suggest dates and choose a shared activity, although the budget still limits the options.
listening.zh: 社團旅行由一年一次巴士外出，變成大家可參與塑造的事：組員現可提日期、選共同活動，但預算仍限制選項。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 旅行由較固定的一次外出，改成組員可影響日期及活動，仍受預算限制。
旅行仍完全按舊巴士行程，組員不能提任何部分。
組員只可回顧過去，尚未有任何新的參與方式。
這描述只報告今年巴士換了外觀，沒有安排方式轉變。

listening.explanationZh: from yearly outing/to members suggest choose 說前後安排轉變，budget保留實際範圍。

reply.promptEn: What has changed in the way the club plans its trip?
reply.promptZh: 社團規劃旅行的方式改了甚麼？

options.en: It has gone from being a yearly coach outing to something people can shape through their suggestions.
options.zh: 它由一年一次巴士外出，變成大家可透過建議塑造的事。

options.en: Members now have a say in dates and a shared activity.
options.zh: 組員現在可對日期及共同活動發言。

options.en: The old set outing has become a more participatory arrangement.
options.zh: 以往固定外出，變成較有參與的安排。

options.en: We can influence parts of the plan while still working within a budget.
options.zh: 我們可影響計劃部分，同時仍依預算。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 一份歷史圖表寫舊展覽只由老師選題，新展覽讓學生選問題及展示方法；學生不能自行改場地或期限。哪句可保留轉變及界限？

options.en: The exhibition has gone from being a teacher-set task to something people can shape, within the agreed venue and deadline.
options.zh: 展覽由老師定的工作，變成大家可參與塑造，但仍依議好場地及期限。

options.en: The new choice of topic means the venue and deadline are now each student’s decision too.
options.zh: 新選題權表示場地及期限現也由每位學生定。

options.en: The change only concerns when the same teacher-selected display is put up.
options.zh: 改動只關乎何時掛出相同老師所選展品。

scene.explanationZh: 有選問題方法的實質轉變，不把部分選擇擴成所有條件，也不縮成只是時間變。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由這個 from being … to … 的轉變框架得出？

options.en: 應比較先前狀態與現在可塑造的部分。
其中一項選擇增加，就表示全部條件已可任意決定。
仍可同時存在預算、期限或共同約定。

contrast.explanationZh: 塑造能力有範圍，轉變框架本身不取消限制。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說組員可提活動，便應不用理預算；你想肯定參與增加，也留實際條件。哪句最好？

options.en: It has gone from being a set outing to something people can shape, but the suggestions still need to fit our budget.
options.zh: 它由固定外出變成大家可參與塑造，但建議仍需配合預算。

options.en: I thought having a choice of activity meant the costs would be covered regardless of which one we chose.
options.zh: 我以為可選活動，就表示無論選哪項費用都會有人支付。

options.en: I thought members could only comment on an already fixed date, not suggest activities as well.
options.zh: 我以為組員只可對已定日期表示意見，不是也可提活動。

dialogue.explanationZh: 組員可提日期與活動，已有實際參與轉變；預算仍在，不等於所有選擇已有人支付。

speaking.en: The event has gone from being a fixed annual programme to something people can shape by suggesting how they want to take part.
speaking.zh: 活動由固定年度節目，變成大家可透過提參與方式塑造的事。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說先前狀態與現在增加的參與。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫一段圖書館服務介紹。舊閱讀活動每季只辦一場由職員定內容的講座，現在讀者可提出討論問題、申請主持小組，但名額及開放時間仍有限。你要讓新讀者看見實際轉變，也說清如何提交構想，不把提出等同必獲批准。用一至兩句英文介紹。

examples.en: The programme has gone from being an occasional staff-led talk to something people can shape through questions and small-group proposals. Bring an idea to the desk, and we will discuss how it might fit the available places and opening hours.
examples.zh: 節目由偶爾職員帶領講座，變成讀者可透過問題及小組提案塑造的事。可帶構想到櫃枱，我們再談怎配合名額及開放時間。

examples.en: Our reading programme has gone from being a single set event to something people can shape, including by offering to lead a small group. Ask at the desk about submitting a proposal; the spaces and hours still need to be agreed.
examples.zh: 閱讀節目由單一固定活動，變成大家可參與塑造，包括自薦帶小組。可在櫃枱問怎提交提案；名額及時段仍需議定。

glossary.en: Bring an idea to the desk

writing.selfCheckZh: 清楚比較舊活動與新參與方式，提供提案途徑，也留名額時段及確認範圍；不把提案權說成自動獲准。

takeaways.en: The festival has gone from being a single staged show to something people can shape through neighbourhood performances and workshops.
takeaways.zh: 節慶由單一舞台表演，變成大家可透過鄰里表演及工作坊塑造的事。

takeaways.en: Our newsletter has gone from being a notice sheet to something people can shape by proposing questions for interviews.
takeaways.zh: 通訊由公告單張，變成大家可透過提訪問問題塑造的事。

sources.sentence: They will save up for a family holiday.

brief.meaningEn: Accumulate money over time for a particular planned purchase or expense.
brief.meaningZh: 一段時間逐步積存金錢，準備支付某項購買或開支。
brief.grammar: save/saved/am saving up for + noun/-ing; for identifies the purpose of the accumulated money; saving up describes a process, not necessarily enough money already collected
brief.boundaryZh: 正在儲不等於已買、已夠或已決定實際供應；需說想支付甚麼及目前狀態。
brief.misconceptionZh: 正在儲不等於已買、已夠或已決定實際供應；需說想支付甚麼及目前狀態。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「逐步儲錢以支付某事」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: We were saving up for a small recording session, putting part of each club sale aside; by June we had enough for the room, but still needed to ask whether the engineer was available.
listening.zh: 我們為一次小錄音逐步儲錢，每次社團義賣留一部分；到六月夠付房間，但仍需問錄音師有否空。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 小組逐步存款已有房租所需金額，錄音師供應仍待問。
小組已付清錄音並錄完，現在只等賣成品。
小組每次把全部義賣收入花掉，未曾留錢。
六月收到的是錄音師確認，不是累積金額達房租。

listening.explanationZh: putting part aside 是逐步儲；enough room 與 engineer availability 是不同待辦。

reply.promptEn: Why did you put part of each sale aside?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼每次義賣都留一部分錢？

options.en: We were saving up for a recording session rather than spending the whole amount after each sale.
options.zh: 我們在為錄音逐步儲錢，不每次賣後全花。

options.en: We wanted the small amounts to build towards the room cost.
options.zh: 我們想小額逐次累積到房間費用。

options.en: The session was a planned expense we wanted the club to prepare for.
options.zh: 錄音是我們想讓社團預先準備的一項開支。

options.en: Keeping some income back gave the club a way to prepare for that later cost.
options.zh: 保留部分收入，讓社團可準備之後那項費用。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 學生每周留十元準備買畫簿，仍未到所需金額；同伴因看見她記了想買款式，就說她已買到。哪句較準確？

options.en: She is saving up for a sketchbook, not reporting that she has already bought it.
options.zh: 她在為畫簿逐步儲錢，不是說已買到。

options.en: Choosing a model confirms that she has completed the purchase.
options.zh: 選定款式確認她已完成購買。

options.en: The weekly money is a refund from a sketchbook she no longer owns.
options.zh: 每周那筆錢是她已不持有畫簿的退款。

scene.explanationZh: 每周留錢及未到目標描述過程；想買款式與實際已買不同。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 saving up for something 得出？

options.en: 正逐步積錢供某項用途。
相關物品或服務已買妥。
仍可需問目前存多少，以及供應或價格情況。

contrast.explanationZh: 儲錢過程不等於交易完成。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說你們夠付錄音室，就可通知大家錄音師已訂好；你們仍未問他時間。哪句回應最好？

options.en: We saved up for the room, but the engineer’s availability is a separate question; let us ask before confirming a date.
options.zh: 我們儲夠房間費，但錄音師有否空是另一問題；確認日期前先問。

options.en: I assumed having the room money meant the engineer’s time was included in our arrangement.
options.zh: 我以為有房間費，就表示安排已包括錄音師時間。

options.en: I would set the date now and find out about the engineer only when we arrive.
options.zh: 我會現在定日期，到場時才查錄音師安排。

dialogue.explanationZh: 有款項不自動有服務時段；先問實際供應才確認。

speaking.en: I am saving up for a short course, but I still need to check the dates before I make a booking.
speaking.zh: 我在為短課程逐步儲錢，但訂前仍需核日期。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分儲款目的與已訂狀態。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：故事中的社團一直為露天放映儲錢，但該場活動已因場地取消而不再舉行。一位成員提議直接把款項改作聚餐，你想先向組員交代原目標已變，再共同決定款項新用途，不把已籌到的錢當任何人可自行使用。用一至兩句英文提出商量。

examples.en: We were saving up for the outdoor screening, but that event is no longer going ahead. Before using the fund for a meal, could we explain the change and ask members what purpose they now agree to support?
examples.zh: 我們原為戶外放映逐步儲錢，但活動已不再舉行。把款項改作聚餐前，可否先交代改變，問組員現在同意支持甚麼用途？

examples.en: The money we have been saving up for the screening still belongs to a shared purpose, even though the venue has cancelled. Let us discuss a new use together rather than treat the cancellation as permission to spend it elsewhere.
examples.zh: 我們原為放映逐步積存的錢，仍有共同用途，即使場地已取消安排。先一起談新用途，不把取消當成可任意改花的許可。

writing.selfCheckZh: 說清原本儲款目標與已改變的活動狀態，再提出共同決定；不把活動取消當成已同意聚餐或個人可自行花款。

takeaways.en: She saved up for the workshop over several months, then checked that the final session did not clash with her exams.
takeaways.zh: 她為工作坊儲錢數月，再核最後一課有否跟考試撞期。

takeaways.en: They are saving up for a replacement projector and keeping the amount raised separate from the everyday club budget.
takeaways.zh: 他們為替換投影機逐步儲錢，把所存款項與日常社團預算分開。

sources.sentence: They booked a last-minute trip abroad.

brief.meaningEn: Close to the relevant departure, event or deadline, leaving little advance notice; last-minute describes a late arrangement, at the last minute locates an action, and until the last minute describes waiting up to that point.
brief.meaningZh: 在相關出發、事件或期限前不久，預先通知時間很短；last-minute 形容臨時安排，at the last minute 指行動發生的時機，until the last minute 指一直等到臨近該時點。
brief.grammar: a last-minute trip uses a hyphenated adjective before a noun; change a plan at the last minute locates the change; wait or leave a task until the last minute extends the delay up to a late point. The surrounding verb identifies the actual action.
brief.boundaryZh: 描述安排或改變的時機，不自動表示便宜、差、完全沒有準備或之前沒有計劃；需看接近哪件事，以及實際何時決定。
brief.misconceptionZh: 整趟旅程很早已安排，但可以臨近才買票或改一部分；應分清是哪個行動發生得遲。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分清形容詞與時間片語，按實際行動交代短通知或臨近才改變的安排。

listening.en: When my cousin said on Thursday that she could host us that weekend, we arranged a last-minute trip, checking the train times before accepting rather than assuming we could leave whenever we liked.
listening.zh: 表姊周四說那周末可招待，我們便臨出發安排旅程；先核火車時間再答應，不假定隨時可出發。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 旅程周四才為即將到的周末安排，仍有核交通。
旅程幾月前已定，周四只是回覆一直未讀的介紹。
兩人未看交通便已到表姊家，沒有行前核對。
表姊拒絕那周末接待，所以兩人定下年再去。

listening.explanationZh: Thursday/that weekend 說短籌備期，不是完全無準備或幾月前已定。

reply.promptEn: Why do you call it a last-minute arrangement?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼說這安排很臨時？

options.en: It was a last-minute trip because we only received the invitation on Thursday for that weekend.
options.zh: 周四才收到那周末邀請，所以是臨出發才安排的旅程。

options.en: There were only a couple of days between the invitation and leaving.
options.zh: 邀請與出發之間只有一兩天。

options.en: We had not been planning that visit for months beforehand.
options.zh: 我們之前沒有計劃那探訪數月。

options.en: The opportunity came up shortly before the dates we could use.
options.zh: 機會在可用日子前不久才出現。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 一家人一月已決定八月探親、約好住宿及假期，七月底才買車票。旁白要分清整趟旅程與買票時間。哪句較準確？

options.en: The ticket purchase was late, but this account does not describe arranging a last-minute trip.
options.zh: 買票較遲，但這敘述不把整趟旅行描述為臨出發才安排。

options.en: The visit should be described as a last-minute trip because the tickets were bought in July.
options.zh: 因為車票七月才買，整趟探訪便應被描述為臨出發才安排的旅程。

options.en: The family received the first invitation only after buying the tickets in July.
options.zh: 一家人七月買票後，才首次收到邀請。

scene.explanationZh: 整體探訪、住宿與假期早已安排；七月才買票，只說明購票較遲，不把一月的計劃變成臨時旅程。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 a last-minute trip 得出？

options.en: 旅程在出發前不久才安排。
旅費必定比提早安排更便宜。
仍可在有限時間內核交通及住宿。

contrast.explanationZh: 時間標籤不給價格比較或準備程度保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想因邀請突然便直接出發，沒問回程火車；你願去，但需周日晚回來。哪句最合適？

options.en: I am interested in a last-minute trip, but let us check the Sunday return before accepting the invitation.
options.zh: 我有興趣臨時旅行，但答應邀請前先核周日回程。

options.en: I would confirm first and assume there will be a train at the time we need.
options.zh: 我會先確認，假定需要時間會有火車。

options.en: I thought a spontaneous invitation meant we should avoid agreeing on a return time.
options.zh: 我以為臨時邀請表示不應議定回來時間。

dialogue.explanationZh: 短準備時間仍可核關鍵限制，不把臨時當沒有時限或交通保證。

speaking.en: We considered a last-minute trip after receiving the invitation, but waited until we had checked the journey home.
speaking.zh: 收到邀請後，我們考慮臨時旅行，但先等核回程。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分臨時機會與確認前要查的安排。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友以為你上周突然離城是避開已約的聚會，你想解釋是臨出發收到家人探訪機會，之前已請聚會伙伴同意改期，也想確認新的見面日子。用一至兩句英文澄清，不把「臨時」當不用通知的理由。

examples.en: It was a last-minute trip after my family offered a chance to visit, not a plan to avoid our gathering. I checked with you about moving it first, and I would like to confirm the new date now.
examples.zh: 那是家人提供探訪機會後的臨時旅行，不是想避聚會。我先跟你問過改期，現在想確認新日期。

examples.en: The family invitation led to a last-minute trip, which is why I asked to rearrange our meeting. Thank you for agreeing; could we settle the replacement date rather than leave it uncertain?
examples.zh: 家人邀請帶來臨時旅行，所以我才請改見面。謝謝同意；可否定替代日期，不繼續未定？

writing.selfCheckZh: 交代臨時安排的時序及先已商量改期，再確認替代日子；不把突然機會當可忽略已有約定。

takeaways.en: A last-minute trip became possible when a cancelled booking left room for us at my aunt’s house.
takeaways.zh: 有人取消預約後，姨母家有位置接待我們，臨時旅行才可行。

takeaways.en: Do not leave the seating plan until the last minute; the ushers need it before rehearsal.
takeaways.zh: 不要等到最後一刻才處理座位表；帶位員在綵排前就需要它。
