sources.sentence: With phones, modern life tends to follow people wherever they go.
sources.expression: modern life tends to follow people wherever they go

brief.meaningEn: Everyday demands, especially work and digital contact, can continue to reach people even when they change location.
brief.meaningZh: 即使人換了地方，日常要求，尤其工作及數碼聯絡，仍可能持續找上門。
brief.grammar: modern life follows us wherever we go; modern life tends to follow people wherever they go; life is personified as following, while the actual demands need to be named
brief.boundaryZh: 描述持續要求的傾向，不是每個旅行者必受影響，也不表示每種聯絡都妨礙休息；需看實際內容及安排。
brief.misconceptionZh: 描述持續要求的傾向，不是每個旅行者必受影響，也不表示每種聯絡都妨礙休息；需看實際內容及安排。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「日常要求隨人一路跟來」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Creative personification of everyday demands, rather than a fixed idiom or a claim that modern life is a physical pursuer.

listening.en: It seemed that modern life follows us wherever we go: even at the lakeside cabin, work requests filled the morning chat, and we spent our first hour deciding what needed a reply.
listening.zh: 日常要求彷彿一路跟來：即使在湖邊小屋，早晨群聊仍滿工作請求，我們首小時都在定哪些需回覆。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 換到湖邊後，工作訊息仍佔了原想休息的時間。
兩人早已停止接收工作訊息，首小時只談湖景。
工作要求只在回家後才出現，小屋沒有任何聯絡。
人物只擔心旅行行李，沒有工作訊息內容。

listening.explanationZh: even cabin/work requests 說原有要求跨地點持續，不是所有現代聯絡都一樣。

reply.promptEn: What interrupted the first morning at the cabin?
reply.promptZh: 小屋首個早晨被甚麼打斷？

options.en: Modern life follows us wherever we go, it seemed: the work requests were still coming into the chat.
options.zh: 日常要求彷彿一路跟來：工作請求仍進群聊。

options.en: We were still deciding how to respond to the usual work messages.
options.zh: 我們仍在決定怎回平常工作訊息。

options.en: The location changed, but the morning demands had not been left behind.
options.zh: 地方變了，早晨要求卻沒放下。

options.en: The first hour went into deciding which requests needed an answer rather than the quiet time we had hoped for.
options.zh: 首小時用來決定哪些請求需要回覆，而不是我們原希望的安靜時間。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 旅客用電話跟家人報平安，之後把工作群聊留到回程，整下午自在看展。有人只因見電話便說日常工作跟足全日。哪句較準確？

options.en: The phone alone does not show that modern life follows us wherever we go in the sense of continuing work demands.
options.zh: 只見電話，未顯示日常要求以持續工作的意思一路跟來。

options.en: The family update should be classified as an ordinary work request rather than personal contact.
options.zh: 那則給家人近況應被算成平常工作要求，不是私人聯絡。

options.en: The traveller has reported spending the exhibition replying to the work chat.
options.zh: 旅客已說整段看展都在回工作群聊。

scene.explanationZh: 按訊息用途及之後行為分清家庭聯絡與工作，不把持有電話當持續工作。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由這個日常要求跟隨旅行者的比喻得出？

options.en: 換地點未必已放下原有要求。
使用電話的每個人必定無法休息。
仍需指出哪些訊息或責任實際持續。

contrast.explanationZh: 傾向及特定情況不等於人人每次都被打擾。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說只要離家夠遠，工作就自然不會找你；你們仍在小屋收到請求。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: Modern life follows us wherever we go when the same work channels stay active; could we agree which requests wait until our return?
options.zh: 相同工作管道仍開着，日常要求就一路跟來；可否議哪些請求留回來？

options.en: I thought distance would change which messages reached the group, even with the same notification settings.
options.zh: 即使通知設定相同，我以為距離也會改變哪些訊息傳到群組。

options.en: I would answer every routine request immediately and decide on a boundary only after the stay.
options.zh: 我會即回每項日常要求，住完才定界限。

dialogue.explanationZh: 地點不代聯絡安排，需商量實際回覆範圍及時間。

speaking.en: Modern life tends to follow people wherever they go when their usual work messages remain part of each day.
speaking.zh: 平常工作訊息仍佔每天時，日常要求往往一路跟着人走。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出實際跟來的要求。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你到朋友家短住，沒能好好參加他準備的晚飯，因自己一直回學生社團的工作訊息。朋友以為是他家不夠有趣，你想道歉並澄清是自己把日常要求帶來，感謝他的安排，再問能否另留一段真正共處的時間。用一至兩句英文寫給他。

examples.en: I am sorry I was distracted at dinner; modern life seemed to follow me wherever I went through the club messages I kept answering. Your welcome mattered to me, and I would like to arrange another evening when I can give our conversation my attention.
examples.zh: 對不起，晚飯時我分心；我一直回社團訊息，日常要求彷彿一路跟來。我珍惜你的招待，想再約一晚，讓自己專注談話。

examples.en: Modern life follows us wherever we go when we keep the same demands active, and I brought that pattern to your table. Thank you for the meal; could we choose another time together after I have handed over the club replies?
examples.zh: 持續接着相同要求，日常就一路跟來，而我把那模式帶到你的餐桌。謝謝晚飯；我交接社團回覆後，可否另選共處時間？

writing.selfCheckZh: 為自己分心道歉，把原因連到實際仍回覆的要求，感謝朋友招待並商量再共處；不把注意力不足怪在朋友家，也不代對方說已原諒。

takeaways.en: Modern life follows us wherever we go, we joked, as the familiar committee reminder arrived just after we reached the island.
takeaways.zh: 剛到島便收到熟悉委員會提醒，我們笑說日常要求一路跟來。

takeaways.en: Modern life seemed to follow me wherever I went: even at my cousin’s kitchen table, the school committee kept asking me to approve the same notices.
takeaways.zh: 日常要求彷彿一路跟來：即使坐在表姊的廚房餐桌旁，學校委員會仍不斷請我批核那些公告。

lessons.titleEn: a change of scenery with Wi-Fi

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Without rest, the trip became a change of scenery with Wi-Fi.
sources.expression: a change of scenery with Wi-Fi

brief.meaningEn: A pointed description of travel that changes the surroundings while leaving ordinary work or digital distractions largely intact.
brief.meaningZh: 帶點批評地形容只換了環境，平常工作或數碼干擾卻大致照舊的旅行。
brief.grammar: the break became/was only a change of scenery with Wi-Fi; explain what remained unchanged, since having internet alone does not imply the trip lacked rest
brief.boundaryZh: 批評針對沒有實際放下日常要求，不是有網絡便一定無休息；需有原本期待與實際行為對比。
brief.misconceptionZh: 批評針對沒有實際放下日常要求，不是有網絡便一定無休息；需有原本期待與實際行為對比。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「只是帶着網絡換個景」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Creative pointed comparison, not a fixed technical category of trip. Wi-Fi evokes continued connection in this particular contrast.

listening.en: I had hoped for time together, but the holiday became a change of scenery with Wi-Fi: we kept the same work calls and ate separately beside our laptops, just with the sea outside the window.
listening.zh: 我原想共處，但假期變成只是帶網絡換景：照開工作通話、各在電腦旁吃飯，只是窗外變海。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 景色改了，原想共處的時間卻仍被相同工作方式佔着。
兩人關掉工作通話，整天一起在海邊吃飯。
小住只因不能上網而取消，兩人沒有到海邊。
原本安排就是遠程上班，說話者沒期待共處休息。

listening.explanationZh: hoped together 與 same calls/separate meals 對比，指出原期待沒實現，不單指有網絡。

reply.promptEn: Why did the holiday disappoint you?
reply.promptZh: 假期為甚麼令你失望？

options.en: It became a change of scenery with Wi-Fi instead of the shared break I had wanted.
options.zh: 它變成只是帶網絡換景，不是我想要的共處休息。

options.en: The work calls and separate laptop meals carried on much as before.
options.zh: 工作通話及各對電腦吃飯跟之前差不多。

options.en: The sea view changed, but how we spent our time together did not.
options.zh: 海景變了，但我們怎用共處時間沒有改。

options.en: I had hoped for a different pace rather than the same routine beside another window.
options.zh: 我原想步調不同，不是在另一窗旁過同一日常。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物在假期用旅館網絡跟家人報平安及查地圖，其餘時間跟朋友散步，沒有工作通話。有人只見 Wi-Fi 字樣便用這句諷刺整趟休息。哪句較準確？

options.en: Internet access alone does not make this a change of scenery with Wi-Fi in the critical sense; the account includes a genuine pause from work.
options.zh: 單有網絡，不令它成批評意思中只是帶網絡換景；敘述有實際暫停工作。

options.en: The map search establishes that the ordinary work routine continued throughout the holiday.
options.zh: 查地圖確立整個假期仍照舊工作。

options.en: The friends spent the walks answering the same office calls as before.
options.zh: 兩人散步時一直回平常辦公室通話。

scene.explanationZh: 批評需有實際日常要求照舊，不能單用網絡設備判旅行感受。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由這個帶批評的換景加網絡描述得出？

options.en: 環境改變，原本要求或干擾卻仍在。
只要有無線網絡，任何旅行都不可能有真正休息。
可比較原期待與實際時間怎被使用。

contrast.explanationZh: 批評是具體行為的對比，不是所有網絡用途都妨礙休息。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說「下次換更漂亮海景房，就算照開全部工作通話，也會不同吧？」你想先改共處時間安排。哪句最好？

options.en: I do not want another change of scenery with Wi-Fi; could we agree on some time without the usual calls before choosing the room?
options.zh: 我不想再只是帶網絡換景；選房前，可否議一段沒有平常通話的時間？

options.en: I would choose the better window view first and expect it to change how much time the calls take.
options.zh: 我會先選較好窗景，期望它改變通話佔多少時間。

options.en: I thought the problem was only the destination, not the work pattern we brought with us.
options.zh: 我以為問題只在目的地，不在我們帶來的工作模式。

dialogue.explanationZh: 要回應時間使用方式，不把更美房景當工作量或共處保證。

speaking.en: I wanted a shared break, not just a change of scenery with Wi-Fi and the same work meetings at a different desk.
speaking.zh: 我想共處休息，不只是帶網絡換景，在另一枱照開工作會。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說原期待與照舊的行為。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你打算到外地借住一周繼續遙距工作，朋友以為你邀他一同度假、每天都可共遊。你想在他答應前講清這主要是換環境工作，不把有海景和網絡就稱作真正休假；若他想一起休息，可另議一個你能放下工作的時段。用一至兩句英文說明邀請。

examples.en: I should describe this as a change of scenery with Wi-Fi, since I will be working most weekdays rather than taking a shared holiday. Would a working stay suit you, or should we plan a separate break when I can leave the calls behind?
examples.zh: 這趟應說成有網絡可用的換環境工作之旅，因為我大部分平日都需要工作，並不是和你一起度假。這種短住適合你嗎，還是我們應另議一段我可以放下工作通話的休息時間？

examples.en: Before you accept, I should make clear that this would be a change of scenery with Wi-Fi, not a week of free afternoons together. If you want a shared holiday, I would rather choose another time than promise company I cannot give.
examples.zh: 在你答應之前，我應先說清楚：這會是有網絡可用的換環境工作之旅，而不是一整周每個下午都有空陪你的假期。若你想一起度假，我寧願另選時間，也不想承諾自己給不了的陪伴。

glossary.zh: 在另一個環境工作的短住
一整周每個下午都有空

writing.selfCheckZh: 在朋友承諾前說明工作型短住的實際時間，讓他選是否適合或另議休假；不把景色與網絡包裝成已能陪伴的假期。

takeaways.en: The new location could become a change of scenery with Wi-Fi if we simply move the entire working timetable there.
takeaways.zh: 若只把整份工作時間表搬過去，新地點可變成只是帶網絡換景。

takeaways.en: She called it a change of scenery with Wi-Fi after spending the first two days on the same reports she had hoped to leave behind.
takeaways.zh: 原想放下的報告仍佔了首兩天，她便稱只是帶網絡換景。

sources.sentence: People may travel far, but they do not fully arrive.
sources.expression: travel far, but they do not fully arrive

brief.meaningEn: Reach a distant destination physically while remaining mentally caught in the routines one meant to leave.
brief.meaningZh: 身體到達遠方，心裏卻仍被原想暫離的日常牽着。
brief.grammar: travel far without fully arriving; far describes physical distance, while fully arriving is a figurative mental presence at the destination
brief.boundaryZh: 不是說人沒有抵達地址，也不由看一次訊息便斷整趟沒在場；需有持續分心及原期待的情境。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是說人沒有抵達地址，也不由看一次訊息便斷整趟沒在場；需有持續分心及原期待的情境。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「身到遠方，心卻未到」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Creative contrast between physical arrival and mental presence. The two senses of arriving are deliberately contrasted, not a literal contradiction.

listening.en: We had travelled far without fully arriving: although we were sitting beside the harbour, I kept planning Monday’s meeting and missed most of what my brother said about the boats.
listening.zh: 我們身到遠方、心卻未到：雖坐海港旁，我仍不停計劃周一會議，錯過弟弟大部分說船的話。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 說話者已在海港，但心思仍在會議，未留意共處談話。
兩人因交通延誤，仍未到達海港地址。
說話者專注聽船的事，回家後才想起會議。
弟弟整段談話都在協助計劃周一會議。

listening.explanationZh: sitting harbour 與 kept planning/missed words 對比實體到達及心神沒投入。

reply.promptEn: What do you mean by saying you had not fully arrived?
reply.promptZh: 你說沒有真正到場，是甚麼意思？

options.en: I had travelled far without fully arriving, because I was still mentally occupied by the meeting.
options.zh: 我身到遠方、心卻未到，因心思仍被會議佔據。

options.en: My body was at the harbour, but my attention was on Monday’s work.
options.zh: 身在海港，注意力卻在周一工作。

options.en: I missed much of the conversation because I was rehearsing another task in my head.
options.zh: 我在腦中排演另一工作，所以錯過大部分談話。

options.en: The destination had changed before my attention had caught up with it.
options.zh: 目的地變了，我的注意力還沒跟上。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 旅客到埗後先用五分鐘報平安，其後整下午專心聽朋友說話、參觀，也說很投入。有人只因那五分鐘便形容全程心未到。哪句較準確？

options.en: One brief message does not establish that she travelled far without fully arriving; the later account describes her attention returning to the visit.
options.zh: 一則短訊未確立她身到遠方、心卻未到；之後敘述顯示注意力已回到探訪。

options.en: The five-minute update means she remained mentally absent for the whole afternoon.
options.zh: 五分鐘近況表示她整下午心神都不在。

options.en: She spent the visit rehearsing work instead of listening to her friend.
options.zh: 她整段探訪在排演工作，不是聽朋友。

scene.explanationZh: 按持續行為及範圍，不把一則短訊擴成整天；後段明說投入。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由這個身到遠方、心卻未到的對比得出？

options.en: 人已在目的地，注意力仍困在別處。
地理地址必定找錯，身體還未抵達。
需具體說心思仍在哪裏，以及漏過甚麼。

contrast.explanationZh: 這裏沒到是心理投入的比喻，不是位置錯誤報告。

dialogue.promptZh: 弟弟說：「你人在旁邊，我說的你應全聽到吧？」你知道自己仍想會議。哪句回應最好？

options.en: I had travelled far without fully arriving, and I missed part of what you said; could you tell me again while I put the work plan aside?
options.zh: 我身到遠方、心卻未到，漏了你部分話；我放下工作計劃後，可否再說一次？

options.en: I thought sitting beside you meant I had taken in the whole conversation, even while thinking about Monday.
options.zh: 即使想周一事，我以為坐你旁邊便表示全段談話都吸收了。

options.en: I would answer from what I expect you said rather than ask which part I missed.
options.zh: 我會按猜想你說的內容回答，不問漏了哪部分。

dialogue.explanationZh: 承認漏聽並重回注意力，不用位置代理解，或以猜內容代再問。

speaking.en: It is possible to travel far without fully arriving when the task left at home still takes all of our attention.
speaking.zh: 留下的工作仍佔全部注意力時，可能身到遠方、心卻未到。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分實體到達與注意力所在。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫旅後反思，照片顯示去了許多地方，日記卻大多只記「趕下一站」，想不起跟同行者談了甚麼。你想比較走得遠與是否留意眼前，提出下次先選少些景點、留共處時間，不自稱所有記憶都沒有價值。用一至兩句英文反思。

examples.en: Looking at my diary, I think I travelled far without fully arriving: most entries are about rushing to the next stop. Next time I would like fewer destinations and more time to notice the people beside me.
examples.zh: 看日記，我覺得自己身到遠方、心卻未到：大部分只記趕下一站。下次我想少些目的地，多些留意身旁人的時間。

examples.en: We can travel far without fully arriving if the next stop keeps taking our attention away from this one. I want to leave room for a conversation next time, rather than measure the visit only by the number of places reached.
examples.zh: 若下一站不斷把注意力從當下拉走，我們可身到遠方、心卻未到。下次我想留談話空間，不只按到過幾處量度探訪。

writing.selfCheckZh: 按日記具體比較到處走與投入當下，提出少些地點及共處時間；不把照片數量當心神在場，也不一概貶所有經歷。

takeaways.en: They travelled far without fully arriving, discussing the next deadline throughout the walk they had once looked forward to.
takeaways.zh: 原曾期待的散步全程都談下一期限，他們身到遠方、心卻未到。

takeaways.en: I did not want to travel far without fully arriving, so I asked for an unhurried hour with my cousin instead of adding another stop.
takeaways.zh: 我不想身到遠方、心卻未到，所以請留一小時從容陪表弟，不再多加一站。

lessons.titleZh: 世界的選擇與機會擴闊了

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: For tourists, the world may have opened up.
sources.expression: the world may have opened up

brief.meaningEn: A wider range of experiences, opportunities or places has become accessible to someone.
brief.meaningZh: 對某人而言，可接觸的經驗、機會或地方範圍擴大了。
brief.grammar: the world has opened up for someone; the world may have opened up leaves the judgement tentative; open up is figurative increased access here, not physically opening the planet
brief.boundaryZh: 機會擴闊不等於每個人已可負擔、進入所有選擇；may 保留可能，需說對誰、哪種機會及仍有甚麼限制。
brief.misconceptionZh: 機會擴闊不等於每個人已可負擔、進入所有選擇；may 保留可能，需說對誰、哪種機會及仍有甚麼限制。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「世界的選擇與機會擴闊了」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: Since the arts centre linked us with online workshops, the world has opened up for our rural club: we can hear artists we could not previously reach, although live visits still depend on time and cost.
listening.zh: 藝術中心連上網上工作坊後，鄉郊社團的選擇擴闊了：可聽以前接觸不到的藝術家，但親身探訪仍看時間費用。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 網上連繫增加可接觸藝術家的機會，親訪限制仍在。
社團以前已可聽完全相同藝術家，接觸範圍沒有變。
網上工作坊只提供場地地圖，未能聽藝術家。
社團已安排所有藝術家到訪，時間費用不再待考慮。

listening.explanationZh: previously unreachable/now hear 指接觸擴闊，although保留親訪條件。

reply.promptEn: What has the arts centre’s online link changed?
reply.promptZh: 藝術中心的網上連繫改了甚麼？

options.en: The world has opened up for the club through artists we can now hear online.
options.zh: 透過現可網上聽的藝術家，社團的世界擴闊了。

options.en: We can reach people whose workshops were previously beyond our access.
options.zh: 我們可接觸以前參加不到其工作坊的人。

options.en: There are more ways to learn, even though travelling to meet them still has limits.
options.zh: 學習方法更多，即使去見他們仍有限制。

options.en: The connection has widened our choices without settling every practical arrangement.
options.zh: 連繫擴大選擇，但未定所有實際安排。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 新交換計劃增加三地申請機會，但某學生只能參加其中一種有合適時段的安排；介紹想承認變化，又不聲稱她每項都可選。哪句較準確？

options.en: The world may have opened up through the programme, but her available choices still depend on the timetable.
options.zh: 透過計劃，機會可能擴闊了，但她可選範圍仍看時間表。

options.en: The added programmes all share the student’s available hours, so she can choose by destination alone.
options.zh: 新增計劃的時段都配合該學生，所以她可只按目的地選擇。

options.en: Her difficulty is choosing a preferred country rather than finding a compatible timetable.
options.zh: 她的難處是選喜歡的國家，而不是找合適的時間表。

scene.explanationZh: 資料說只有一項時段合適，限制是時間相容，不是單純目的地喜好；新增機會仍需按實際條件篩選。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 the world may have opened up for them 得出？

options.en: 他們可能有更多可接觸經驗或機會。
所有新機會都已確定可行，而且每人條件相同。
仍需看誰有何種實際途徑與限制。

contrast.explanationZh: may與對誰的條件需保留，擴闊不等於每項已可行。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說既可網上聽藝術家，便不用再問哪個工作坊合你們時段；你想先看實際可參與的選項。哪句最好？

options.en: The world has opened up for us, but let us compare the workshop times before choosing which opportunity we can actually use.
options.zh: 我們的機會擴闊了，但選實際可用那項前，先比工作坊時段。

options.en: I assumed the new connection meant each workshop would be scheduled around our club’s usual meeting.
options.zh: 我以為新連繫表示每個工作坊都會依社團平常聚會安排。

options.en: I would choose the most distant artist first and ask about the timing after confirming our place.
options.zh: 我會先選最遠藝術家，確認位置後才問時間。

dialogue.explanationZh: 機會更多仍需比較實際條件，不假定全部圍繞自己時間，也不先承諾才查。

speaking.en: The world has opened up for us through these new connections, but I want to choose an opportunity we can give enough time to.
speaking.zh: 新連繫讓我們的機會擴闊，但我想選一項有足夠時間投入的。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把新選擇與實際可投入的條件並列。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：故事人物原只讀得到家附近書架的幾本書，學會另一種語言後，第一次能讀外地作者的來信。你替她寫一封回信，說明新接觸讓世界擴闊，挑一個真的想問作者的問題，不自稱已理解那地方所有人。用一至兩句英文寫回信。

examples.en: The world has opened up for me now that I can read your letters in their original language. Could you tell me how the ordinary morning in your story connects with the neighbourhood you grew up in?
examples.zh: 現在可用原文讀你的信，我的世界擴闊了。可否說你故事中平常的早晨，怎跟成長的社區連起來？

examples.en: Since I began reading your letters, the world has opened up beyond the few books I knew at home. I would love to ask why you chose the market as the place where your two characters first speak.
examples.zh: 開始讀你的信後，我的世界超出在家熟悉那幾本書而擴闊。我想問為何選市場作兩角色首次說話的地方。

glossary.en: the neighbourhood you grew up in

writing.selfCheckZh: 把接觸擴闊連到可讀原文信件及具體提問，保持好奇；不把讀一作者當已代表整地文化或所有人的生活。

takeaways.en: The world had opened up for her through the library’s new recordings, and she began asking which speaker she wanted to hear next.
takeaways.zh: 圖書館新錄音讓她的世界擴闊，她開始問下一位想聽誰。

takeaways.en: The world may have opened up for the exchange students, but they still needed help choosing a project that fitted their stay.
takeaways.zh: 交換生的機會可能擴闊了，但仍需幫忙選配合逗留時間的項目。
